item.title: German firms lift China investment as US outlays fall, IW study shows
item.description: German companies increased investment in China by a third in the first half of 2026 while sharply reducing investment in the United States, according to a study by the German Economic Institute (IW) seen by Reuters on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German companies increased investment in China by a third in the first half of 2026 while sharply reducing investment in the United States, according to a study by the German Economic Institute (IW) seen by Reuters on Sunday. German firms invested €5.6 billion ($6.50 billion) more in China than in the same period of the previous year, based on IW's analysis of Bundesbank data. The figure was in line with the average half-year investment level between 2020 and 2025. "German companies have little choice but to continue investing in China," IW's Juergen Matthes said, describing the country as both an important sales market and a "gym" where companies can build up their competitive muscle. Matthes said state subsidies and an undervalued yuan made production in China artificially cheap, encouraging German companies to expand locally to compete with Chinese rivals globally. "For Germany, this means production and jobs are shifting to China," Matthes said. "The EU should put a stop to this unfair game and impose countervailing tariffs on Chinese imports." Investment in the U.S. fell by nearly two-thirds to around €4.3 billion, the study said, amid trade tensions and U.S. tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump. ($1 = 0.8615 euros)

item.title: Campeón Cruz Azul vence al América en clásico del torneo mexicano
item.description: Cruz Azul, vigente campeón del fútbol mexicano, ganó el sábado por 4-3 al América en uno de los clásicos que enfrentó a dos de los clubes más populares del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cruz Azul, vigente campeón del fútbol mexicano, ganó el sábado por 4-3 al América en uno de los clásicos que enfrentó a dos de los clubes más populares del país. La "Máquina Celeste" venció a las "Águilas" con goles de Erik Lira, del argentino José Antonio Paradela, Jesús "Chiquete" Orozco y del uruguayo Gabriel "Toro" Fernández. Para América anotaron el uruguayo Brian Rodríguez, y los colombianos Óscar Perea y Miguel Borja. Cruz Azul tomó el control del partido disputado en el estadio Azteca de Ciudad de México, y se puso en ventaja a los 19 minutos con un potente y colocado disparo de Lira dentro del área, metiendo el balón por el ángulo derecho tras recibir un pase de Paradela, quien marcó el segundo gol a los 35 con un potente zurdazo en el área tras controlar un pase de Carlos Rodríguez. Tres minutos después, el portero colombiano Kevin Mier evitó el gol del América al desviar un peligroso remate de cabeza de Henry Martín. La situación para América empeoró a los 41 minutos cuando el árbitro Luis Enrique Santander marcó penal a favor de Cruz Azul tras revisar en el VAR una jugada donde el defensor Ramón Juárez derribó dentro del área a Paradela con una falta por atrás. Pero dos minutos después, el portero Rodolfo Cota atajó el tiro penal del argentino Nicolás Ibáñez. A pesar del penal fallado, Cruz Azul siguió buscando el tercer gol que consiguió al minuto 45 cuando Orozco remató en el área chica un tiro de esquina enviado desde el sector derecho. Un minuto después, América estuvo cerca de anotar con un disparo del brasileño Raphael Veiga que pegó en el poste izquierdo. En la segunda parte, América salió a presionar en busca del gol que estuvo cerca de lograr a los 50 minutos con un remate de cabeza de Juárez que pegó en el poste izquierdo. El equipo dirigido por el uruguayo Guillermo Almada consiguió el descuento a los 52 minutos cuando el delantero uruguayo Brian Rodríguez metió el balón por el ángulo derecho al cobrar un tiro de castigo desde fuera del área. Pese a la presión de América, Cruz Azul logró el cuarto gol a los 72 minutos cuando el "Toro" Fernández definió de derecha tras eludir al portero después de recibir un largo pase de Lira. Cerca del final, América marcó el segundo gol con un zurdazo de Perea a los 90 minutos. En la siguiente jugada, Borja metió el tercer gol al definir de derecha después de que Mier rechazó débilmente un potente disparo de Alejandro Zendejas. Con su quinto triunfo, Cruz Azul llegó a 15 puntos para subir del octavo al tercer lugar general, por abajo de Toluca y América, que registran 16 unidades cada uno. En los otros partidos del sábado, Toluca goleó por 5-2 al Atlas con tantos de Alexis Vega, Jesús Angulo, del uruguayo Federico Viñas, del portugués Paulinho y del zaguero Jorge Rodríguez en su propia portería. Para los "Rojinegros" del Atlas anotaron el argentino Florián Monzón y el caboverdiano Luis De Barros "Duk". En tanto, Monterrey y Tigres UANL empataron 0-0. El domingo, Guadalajara enfrentará a Pumas UNAM, mientras que Santos Laguna jugará ante Bravos de Ciudad Juárez. La jornada se completará el lunes cuando León sea local ante el Atlético de San Luis. El viernes, Pachuca goleó como visitante al Atlante por 3-0, Puebla venció por 1-0 como visitante a Necaxa, mientras que Querétaro ganó por 1-0 en su visita a Tijuana.

item.title: Canadiens sign veteran F Chris Kreider to 1-year deal
item.description: Veteran forward Chris Kreider didn't stay a free agent long, signing a one-year contract with the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday, the team announced.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Veteran forward Chris Kreider didn't stay a free agent long, signing a one-year contract with the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday, the team announced. Financial terms were not disclosed, but ESPN reported that Kreider's deal has a $2.15 million average annual value and could be worth as much as $5 million next season if certain conditions are met. The Anaheim Ducks terminated Kreider's contract on Thursday, one day after the 35-year-old went unclaimed on unconditional waivers. Kreider, a Massachusetts native, reportedly was looking to sign with a team in the East. He had one season left -- at a $6.5 million average annual value against the salary cap -- on a seven-year, $45.5 million extension he signed while with the New York Rangers in February 2020. The Ducks said the move gives them more financial flexibility under the salary cap. They are trying to re-sign restricted free agent forward Cutter Gauthier, 22, who led the team with 41 goals and 69 points last season. "I want to thank Chris for his efforts last year and recognize the professionalism he and his representatives demonstrated throughout this process," Anaheim general manager Pat Verbeek said in a statement Thursday. "Our rationale here is straightforward: We needed to create salary-cap flexibility, and this accomplishes that." The Ducks matched a five-year, $90 million offer sheet sent to star center Leo Carlsson by the Philadelphia Flyers in July -- with his $18 million average annual value now the third highest for any NHL player this coming season. The team also signed forward A.J. Greer to a four-year deal and defenseman Pavel Mintyukov to a five-year contract this summer. Kreider recorded 50 points (22 goals, 28 assists) in 75 games during his only season with Anaheim in 2025-26. He added seven points (two goals, five assists) in 12 playoff games. He played his first 13 NHL seasons with the New York Rangers, who drafted him in the first round (19th overall) in 2009. He has 632 points (348 goals, 284 assists), 609 penalty minutes and a plus-117 rating in 958 career games with New York (2012-25) and Anaheim. Kreider led the NHL with 26 power-play goals and 11 game-winning goals during the 2021-22 season, when he scored a career-high 52 goals. The Rangers traded him to the Ducks in June 2025 with a fourth-round draft pick for forward prospect Carey Terrance and a third-round selection that year. Kreider has 83 points (50 goals, 33 assists) in 135 career playoff games. He was a teammate on the Rangers in 2013-15 with Martin St. Louis, now the Canadiens' coach. --Field Level Media

item.title: Sainz to start home Spanish GP 20th after three-place grid penalty
item.description: Carlos Sainz will start the Spanish Grand Prix 20th on the grid on his home turf after receiving a three-place penalty for impeding Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas in Saturday's qualifying session.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Carlos Sainz will start the Spanish Grand Prix 20th on the grid on his home turf after receiving a three-place penalty for impeding Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas in Saturday's [USN:L6N45404Y TEXT:"qualifying"] session. The 32-year-old Williams driver was penalised for impeding Bottas through Turns 6 and 7 during the first phase of qualifying. "The team failed to inform the driver of Car 55 about Car 77 closing in on a flying lap and the driver did not take any action to make way for the incoming car," the FIA said in a statement. "The Stewards determine that Car 55 unnecessarily impeded Car 77." The penalty drops Sainz to 20th on the grid and moves fellow Spaniard Fernando Alonso of Aston Martin, Cadillac's Sergio Perez and Bottas up one place each for Sunday's 57-lap race, the first Formula One grand prix to be held at the Madring. Sainz, a former Ferrari driver and four-time race winner, has endured a frustrating campaign and lies 16th in the drivers' championship with six points. Williams are ninth in the 11-team constructors' standings. Formula One champion Lando Norris secured pole position for McLaren with a superb final lap at the Madring, beating Mercedes championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 0.011 seconds.

item.title: Obama voices caution on AI, urges Democrats to tackle it, NYT says
item.description: Former U.S. President Barack Obama has warned that artificial intelligence could be "dangerous" if not properly managed, and urged Democrats to frame policy and governance agendas to tackle the issue, the New York Times said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former U.S. President Barack Obama has warned that artificial intelligence could be "dangerous" if not properly managed, and urged Democrats to frame policy and governance agendas to tackle the issue, the New York Times said on Sunday. The remarks at a recent private fundraising event come as growing numbers of U.S. lawmakers call for tougher rules on AI systems after dire warnings from two Anthropic researchers that rapid industry progress risks [USN:L6N4520JB TEXT:"extinction of the human race"]. "This is something that is moving very fast in private hands, and if we don't get on top of it, I think can be dangerous," the newspaper quoted Obama as saying on Thursday. Citing a partial transcript of remarks from Obama's office, the paper said he encouraged House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries to help shape a public conversation on AI policy if Democrats regained the House in midterm elections on November 3. "Once you are speaker, I would strongly urge that the Democrats put together a framework for a very public conversation," Obama told Jeffries, the paper added. He also called for candidates in the 2028 presidential race to make AI one of their central agendas, with a very clear plan to tackle the surrounding safety and economic concerns, the paper said. Obama's office did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The extinction concerns were spurred by cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems and AI safety researchers quitting their companies concerned about the technology's risks. On Saturday, Anthropic CEO [USN:L1N45403R TEXT:"Dario Amodei"] urged AI companies to throttle back work on model capabilities amid growing fears of AI misuse, prompting agreement from both OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk, who runs xAI.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝Ｂジェイズ岡本とＷソックス村上1安打、鈴木は代打で四球
item.description: ［１２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１２日、各地で試合を行い、ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手はオリオールズ戦に「６番・三塁」で出場。２打数１安打、２四球だった。ブルージェイズは７─３で勝利した。

ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手はカージナルス戦に「４番・一塁」で出場。４打数１安打１打点、１得点、１四球、２三振だった。ホワイトソックスは６─５の逆転勝ちを収め、連敗を４で止めた。

カブスの鈴木誠也外野手はパイレーツ戦の八回に代打で出場し、四球で出塁した。カブスは４─３で勝ち、２連勝とした。

item.title: サッカー＝レアルが4得点で快勝、エムバペ2ゴール1シストの活躍
item.description: ［マドリード １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マドリード　１２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は１２日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがキリアン・エムバペの２ゴールなどでラヨ・バリェカノに４─１と快勝した。

レアルは前半１４分にエムバペがＰＫを沈めて先制に成功。その３分後、エムバペのアシストからアルバロ・カレーラスが加点し、同３５分にはジュード・ベリンガムのゴールで突き放した。後半立ち上がりに１点を返されたが、同アディショナルタイムにカウンターからエムバペがこの日自身２得点目をマーク。同選手は今季公式戦６試合で７ゴールとなった。

エスパニョールはロベルト・フェルナンデスの２ゴールでオサスナに２─０と完勝。ラシンはアラベスに２─１で競り勝ち、ビルバオとエルチェは１─１のドローに終わった。

５試合を終えてレアルは勝ち点を１２に伸ばし、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと並んだ。

item.title: ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳、中東に「深い懸念」 共同宣言にイラン・ＵＡＥも署名
item.description:
Sarita Chaganti Singh Shivangi Acharya Saurabh Sharma
[ニューデリー １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarita Chaganti Singh　Shivangi Acharya　Saurabh Sharma

[ニューデリー １２日 ロイター] - 有力新興国で構成する「ＢＲＩＣＳ」は１２日、インドの首都ニューデリーで開幕した首脳会議で中東緊迫について「深い懸念」を表し「最大限の自制」を求める共同宣言を全会一致で採択した。米国と軍事衝突が続くイラン、米国と同盟関係にあるアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）との間で調整が難航すると予想されていたが、初日の採択にこぎ着けたことは両国関係に前向きな兆しと受け止められた。

共同宣言は「対話、協議、外交を通じて」国際紛争を平和的に解決するという加盟国の決意が改めて示された。さらに、米国の対イラン経済制裁やウクライナとの紛争をめぐるロシアへの制裁などに関し、貿易をゆがめる「一方的な関税や非関税措置」の増加についても懸念を表明した。

イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は首脳会議の合間にＵＡＥアブダビ首長国のハリド皇太子と会談。米イランの軍事衝突開始以降では、イラン・ＵＡＥ間で最高レベルでの会談となった。

アブダビの報道担当部門はＸへの投稿で、会談では地域・国際問題や緊張緩和、地域の平和と発展を推進するための取り組みについて協議したと説明した。

イランは軍事衝突開始後、ＵＡＥに繰り返し攻撃を仕掛けており、８月下旬にも米軍部隊やヘリコプターが駐留するアルミンハド空軍基地を標的にした。

在インドのイラン大使館は、ペゼシュキアン大統領とハリド皇太子の会談の写真を掲載。会談内容には触れていない。

中国の習近平国家主席は首脳会議で、中東の和平や安定実現のため「しかるべき役割」を果たす用意があると表明。中国国営中央テレビ（ＣＣＴＶ）によると、「当事者は、政治的解決への取り組みを継続し、恒久的で包括的な停戦の達成に向けて努力しなければならない」と述べた。

item.title: Ticket prices for Shelton-Zverev US Open final down 27%
item.description: The chance to witness tennis history has yet to restoke ticket prices for Sunday's men's final at the U.S. Open in New York.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The chance to witness tennis history has yet to restoke ticket prices for Sunday's men's final at the U.S. Open in New York. Ben Shelton is the first Black American male singles player to reach the championship match since Arthur Ashe in 1972. He will take on No. 1 seed Alexander Zverev at the stadium named after Ashe as Shelton attempts to become the first American man to win a Grand Slam singles title since Andy Roddick at the U.S. Open 23 years ago. The get-in price for Sunday's final remains steep at $388, according to TicketData.com. However, that does represent a 27% drop over the past three days. The get-in price has remained relatively stable in the 24 hours since Shelton beat fellow American Frances Tiafoe in their primetime semifinal match. The price did drop to $361 on Saturday afternoon before climbing back up to $400 ahead of the latest dip at 11 p.m. ET. The average get-in price through the first 15 days of the tournament has been $246, which is down from $313 at the same point last year, according to TicketData.com. The get-in price for Saturday's women's final between Elena Rybakina and Aryna Sabalenka settled at $314, a 20% drop over the previous three days. Rybakina won her first U.S. Open crown with a 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 win over the two-time defending champion. Shelton, 23, is the No. 8 seed and will be playing in his first Grand Slam final. He is 0-5 in his career against Germany's Zverev, 29, who claimed his first Grand Slam title earlier this year at the French Open. All five of their previous meetings came during a 16-month stretch spanning August 2024 to November 2025, and none came in a Grand Slam event. Shelton also is the first Black U.S. man to compete in a Grand Slam final since MaliVai Washington lost in the 1996 Wimbledon final. Discussing his feelings about following Ashe to the U.S. Open championship match, Shelton said, "It's a lot of emotion. My dad, my mom have sacrificed a lot for me to be in this position. ... I'm going to need (the fans) on Sunday to bring the energy. I'm going for it here. I'm gonna leave it all on the court. I hope you guys come and back me. Let's do it for the USA." --Field Level Media

item.title: South Korea wins investment treaty dispute with Chinese investor
item.description: South Korea won a final ruling in a 264-billion-won ($197- million) investor-state dispute after a settlement panel rejected Chinese investor Min Fengzhen's challenge of a 2024 claim dismissal, the justice ministry said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea won a final ruling in a 264-billion-won ($197- million) investor-state dispute after a settlement panel rejected Chinese investor Min Fengzhen's challenge of a 2024 claim dismissal, the justice ministry said on Sunday. The decision represents South Korea's first victory in the full hearing of an international investor claim, the ministry said in a statement. The case centred on Min's claim of violation of protections under an investment treaty between South Korea and China arising from a lender's seizure and sale of pledged shares tied to a failed Beijing property project. The original tribunal dismissed the claim in 2024, saying the investment was illegal and therefore not covered by the treaty. The annulment panel also ordered Min to pay South Korea's legal costs of about 1.5 billion won for the annulment matter, the ministry said. ($1=1,341.4600 won)

item.title: Root pleased with England's response to 'unusual summer'
item.description: England have responded excellently to an "unusual summer" marked by a captaincy change, a new coach and off-field incidents, Test captain Joe Root said after his side completed a 3-0 series shutout of Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England have responded excellently to an "unusual summer" marked by a captaincy change, a new coach and off-field incidents, Test captain Joe Root said after his side completed a 3-0 series [USN:L6N45403K TEXT:"shutout of Pakistan"]. The 35-year-old Root, the second-highest run-scorer in Test cricket history, [USN:L1N43W0FU TEXT:"returned as England Test captain"] after all-rounder Ben [USN:L4N43002A TEXT:"Stokes retired from international cricket"]. Root led England in a record 64 Tests between 2017 and 2022, winning 27 of them. Former New Zealand batter Stephen Fleming was appointed head coach in July following the [USN:L6N43E059 TEXT:"sacking of compatriot Brendon McCullum"] after a four-year stint. The build-up to the second Test against Pakistan was [USN:L1N44K037 TEXT:"overshadowed by controversy"] surrounding fast bowler Brydon Carse, who was [USN:L1N44L0L6 TEXT:"dropped from the England squad"] following an incident outside a nightclub in Derby. Despite the distractions, England completed the sweep on Saturday, sealing an eight-wicket victory in the third and final Test at Edgbaston. "There's been a lot of chaos around this series before a ball was bowled," Root said at a press conference. "At the start of the series, we wanted 3-0 and we've been clinical enough to do that. "It's been a very unusual summer, hasn't it? That's probably a better way of putting it. There's been a lot of different things happen. We had a resignation mid-series, there has been a few off-field incidents and we've got a new coach. "Whether you call it chaos, whether you call it unusual, whether you call it unsettling, all are fair. But ultimately, the thing that I care about, and that's most important, is what happens from that. And I think the way that we've responded to that has been excellent. "And the fact that there's now clarity in what is expected of the group moving forward is quite evident and we build on that now." England next host Sri Lanka in a three-match Twenty20 series beginning in Southampton on Tuesday before facing them in three One-Day Internationals.

item.title: Randal Grichuk's 9th-inning homer lifts White Sox past Cardinals
item.description: Randal Grichuk hit a go-ahead two-run home run with two outs in the top of the ninth inning Saturday night for the Chicago White Sox, helping them beat the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 and snap a four-game losing streak.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Randal Grichuk hit a go-ahead two-run home run with two outs in the top of the ninth inning Saturday night for the Chicago White Sox, helping them beat the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 and snap a four-game losing streak. Grichuk went deep with a 1-2 count against closer Riley O'Brien, taking a sinker just over the fence to the opposite field in right, with outfielder Victor Scott II also losing his glove over the fence. Grichuk's 13th home run, against the team that brought him to the majors, trumped a tie-breaking solo shot by Cardinals rookie Leo Bernal against Grant Taylor in the bottom of the eighth. The White Sox (76-72) increased their lead in the AL Central over Cleveland to 1 1/2 games after the Guardians fell 4-3 at Minnesota. The White Sox, trying to make the playoffs after losing at least 100 games in three straight seasons, had led the division by 5 1/2 games before dropping nine of 12. Another former Cardinals player, right-hander Jordan Hicks (3-2), walked a batter but also got one out for the victory. Bryan Hudson got three outs for his eighth save, including a strikeout of pinch-hitter Jordan Walker. Kyle Teel worked a leadoff walk in the ninth against O'Brien, with Brenton Doyle pinch-running for Teel and stealing second base on a pitchout after one out. Doyle initially was called out at second but shortstop Masyn Winn dropped Bernal's throw on the tag at the bag. One out later, Grichuk came to the rescue. O'Brien (3-8) blew his eighth save in 44 chances for the Cardinals (73-76), who have lost six of nine to fall 7 1/2 back of the last National League wild-card spot. The White Sox went 3-for-11 with runners in scoring position and stranded nine, squandering seven walks and three hit batters by Cardinals pitchers. Chicago went 0-for-8 with 12 left on base in the series opener. The White Sox overcame another poor outing from right-hander Luis Castillo, who allowed three runs, four hits and three walks in 2 2/3 innings of relief. Winn had two hits and drove in a pair of runs for the Cardinals, who also got three hits from Nathan Church. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝スペインＧＰ予選で角田15番手、ノリスがＰＰ獲得
item.description: ［マドリード １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マドリード　１２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のスペイン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は１２日、マドリードの新設半市街地コース「マドリング」で予選を行い、レーシングブルズの角田裕毅は１５番手だった。

昨季の総合王者ランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）が今季３回目、通算１９回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が０．０１１秒差の２番手となり、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が３番手に入った。

ルイス・ハミルトン（英国）が４番手、シャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が５番手とフェラーリ勢が続き、総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は６番手、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア、マクラーレン）は７番手。

レーシングブルズのもう１台、アービッド・リンドブラッド（英国）は１０番手だった。

item.title: サッカー＝鈴木フル出場のアストンビラ、今季初得点も勝利ならず
item.description: ［ロンドン １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ロンドン　１２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１２日、各地で試合を行い、ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはノッティンガム・フォレストに１─２で敗れた。

アストンビラは後半１分に先制点を献上。その後、今季リーグ戦初ゴールを奪って同点に追い付いたが、同４３分に決勝ゴールを決められた。アストンビラは開幕４試合で未勝利。守田英正が所属する昇格組のハルはチェルシーと２─２で引き分けた。守田はベンチ入りしなかった。

クリスタルパレスはイプスウィッチに２─３で敗れた。クリスタルパレスの鎌田大地は先発し、２アシストをマーク。後半３９分までプレーした。同僚の冨安健洋は前半３７分から出場。イプスウィッチの前田大然は後半１８分からピッチに入った。

遠藤航が所属するリバプールはフラムとスコアレスドロー。遠藤はベンチ入りしたが、出番はなかった。昨季王者アーセナルはサンダーランドを２─０で下し、開幕４連勝。後半１３分に新戦力ブルーノ・ギマランイスの初ゴールで先制し、アディショナルタイムにブカヨ・サカがＰＫで追加点を挙げた。

トットナムはエバートンと０─０の引き分けに終わった。トットナムがリーグ戦開幕４試合を全て無得点で終えたのは球団史上初めて。

item.title: Myanmar government revokes status and seeks action against UN envoy Kyaw Moe Tun
item.description: Myanmar's military-backed government said on Sunday its permanent representative to the United Nations was undertaking "illegal activities" and that his status had been revoked and withdrawn.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Myanmar's military-backed government said on Sunday its permanent representative to the United Nations was undertaking "illegal activities" and that his status had been revoked and withdrawn. Here are some other details of the situation surrounding UN permanent representative Kyaw Moe Tun: The government said, according to a statement issued by state media, Kyaw Moe Tun was dismissed from the civil service on February 27, 2021, for failing to follow instructions. On February 26, 2021, Kyaw Moe Tun made [USN:L4N2KW4QT TEXT:"an emotional appeal"] to the UN, urging the international community to not legitimize the military, which seized power in a coup. Kyaw Moe Tun was [USN:W1N2LN02M TEXT:"appointed"] by the previous government, led by Aung San Suu Kyi, which was deposed in the 2021 military coup that triggered civil war across the country. Kyaw Moe Tun's [USN:L8N2UP52G TEXT:"status"] as Myanmar's permanent representative has remained unchanged because the UN Credentials Committee has deferred a decision on Myanmar's representation. The UN Credentials Committee is expected to meet following the UN General Assembly in New York later this month, where it could discuss disputes over representation. Pro-democracy groups and the parallel civilian government, the National Unity Government (NUG), have helped Kyaw Moe Tun retain his position through [USN:L1N2PE0DQ TEXT:"international advocacy"] and lobbying campaigns. Myanmar's military authorities have accused him of unauthorized use of state property and mission funds while working with the NUG. The Myanmar government said it is working through INTERPOL, the United States National Central Bureau, American agencies and diplomatic channels to seek legal action against him.

item.title: Wyatt Langford sparks 6-run fifth as Rangers top D-backs
item.description: Wyatt Langford hit a 435-foot homer to open a six-run fifth inning, Elias Diaz had three hits and an RBI, and the Texas Rangers beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-2 on Saturday in Phoenix to even a three-game series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Wyatt Langford hit a 435-foot homer to open a six-run fifth inning, Elias Diaz had three hits and an RBI, and the Texas Rangers beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-2 on Saturday in Phoenix to even a three-game series. Rangers right-hander Nathan Eovaldi, activated from the injured list Saturday, gave up one run over 2 2-3 innings of relief in his first appearance since Aug. 7, though he did not factor in the decision. Eovaldi entered in the sixth with a 6-1 lead and made his first regular-season relief appearance since Aug. 14, 2019, while with Boston. Jacob Latz got the last four outs. Brandon Nimmo had two doubles and an RBI and Josh Jung had two hits and an RBI. Jung was also activated from the injured list Saturday after being out with a left calf strain since July 21. Langford added a double. Tim Tawa tripled and scored, while Pavan Smith and Corbin Carroll had RBIs for the D-backs, who had won five of six. Texas had lost three in a row and five of seven. The Rangers (73-76) gained a game in both the American League West and wild card races. They are two games behind Houston (75-74) in the division and two behind Cleveland for the third AL wild card spot. Texas DH Joc Pederson was struck by a pitch on the right wrist in the fifth and left for a pinch-hitter in the sixth. He missed two months last season with a fractured right hand. D-backs starter Brandon Pfaadt (7-3) gave up six runs and 10 hits in 6 2-3 innings, with seven strikeouts and no walks. The D-backs had won 11 of his last 13 starts. The D-backs (79-70) are 1 1/2 games behind San Diego (80-68) for the third NL wild card spot. The Chicago Cubs (83-66) are one game ahead of Philadelphia (82-67) for the top spot. Texas starter Kumar Rocker gave up one run on two hits in four-plus innings, leaving after walking two to open the fifth with a 6-1 lead. Robert Garcia (1-1) got the next three. Rocker struck out five and walked two. Tawa tripled and scored on Pavin Smith's single for a 1-0 lead in the third. The Rangers had six hits in their six-run fifth. Langford homered before Jake Burger singled, stole second and scored on Diaz's single. After Pederson was hit by a pitch, Corey Seager hit a grounder to first that forced Pederson at second. Pfaadt took a throw at first for a potential inning-ending double play, but after a review, he was deemed to be off the bag. Jung followed with a two-out RBI single, Nimmo added an RBI double and Duran capped the inning with a two-run single. Corbin Carroll's sacrifice fly made it 6-2 in the sixth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rescuers searching for 140 people from Indonesia passenger ship, official says
item.description: Indonesian rescuers were searching on Sunday for 140 people from a passenger ship that was earlier reported missing in the Java Sea after 103 others were evacuated, one of whom died, a search and rescue agency official said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indonesian rescuers were searching on Sunday for 140 people from a passenger ship that was earlier reported missing in the Java Sea after 103 others were evacuated, one of whom died, a search and rescue agency official said. An Indonesian passenger ship carrying 243 people was reported missing after losing contact early on Sunday during bad weather, the search and rescue agency said. The Virgo Transport 8 ship set sail on Saturday from the East Java city of Surabaya to the South Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin before losing contact, the agency said. I Putu Sudayana, the head of the agency's Banjarmasin office, said in a video statement that 103 people had been evacuated using different ships and some of them would be taken to an East Java port. Rescuers launched a search, deploying a team, ships and a helicopter toward the passenger vessel's last known position, he said, without stating what happened to the ship. Indonesia, an archipelago of 17,000 islands, relies heavily on ferries as a key mode of transportation, with sea routes more affordable and readily available than air travel. However, safety standards are not always rigorously enforced, resulting in a relatively high accident rate.

item.title: テニス＝ルバキナが全米ＯＰ初優勝、サバレンカ3連覇ならず
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）は１２日、女子シングルス決勝を行い、第２シードのエレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）が２連覇中のベラルーシ出身、第１シードのアリーナ・サバレンカを破り、初優勝を果たした。

開幕前から足首のけがに悩まされていたルバキナだが、第１セットを６─４で奪うと、第２セットは５─７で落とすも、続くセットを６─２で制し、自身３回目のグランドスラム優勝を達成。今年の全豪ＯＰ、２０２２年のウィンブルドン選手権に続くタイトルを手にした。

世界ランキング１位浮上が確定しているルバキナは「今は言葉が見つからない。開幕前はこんな結果を予想していなかった」とコメント。サバレンカに対して「あなたとの対戦は本当に大変。あなたは限界まで私を追い込んでくれる」と語りかけた。

全米での連勝が１９で途切れたサバレンカは「残念だけど、エレーナを祝福したい。ここをホームのように感じていた。来年もぜひ戻ってきたい。もう少しいいプレーができればよかったが、また来年に」と話した。

item.title: バスケットボール＝女子Ｗ杯、4連覇中の米国とフランスが決勝進出
item.description: ［ベルリン １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ベルリン　１２日　ロイター］ - バスケットボール女子のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）は１２日、準決勝を行い、Ｗ杯４連覇中の米国がスペインに７６─６６で勝利。決勝進出を果たした。

米国は試合序盤にスペインのアグレッシブなディフェンスに苦戦し、１─９とリードされた。しかし控え選手らの活躍で１１─０と波に乗り、２１─１８と試合をひっくり返して第１クオーターを終了。第３クオーターを同点で終えたものの、第４クオーターではスペインを１０点上回った。

米国のブリアナ・スチュワートがチームトップの１６得点を挙げた。米国は１３日の決勝でフランスと対戦する。フランスは開催国ドイツに８６─６４で快勝。Ｗ杯では初の決勝進出を決めた。ギャビー・ウィリアムズが２２得点、５リバウンド、５アシスト、４スチールと活躍した。

２０２４年パリ五輪の決勝では、米国がフランスを６７─６６で下して優勝した。

item.title: イラン、14日外相会議でホルムズ海峡に関する合意署名見込まず＝高官
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１２日 ロイター] - イラン政府の高官は１２日、オマーンで１４日に開催予定の湾岸諸国との外相会議について、封鎖状態にあるホルムズ海峡を含む諸問題について議論する機会となるものの、同海峡に関する合意文書に署名することはないと述べた。

イランはホルムズ海峡の管理を巡り対岸のオマーンと数カ月にわたり交渉を続けてきた。オマーンはかねてより、この交渉がペルシャ湾に面する他のアラブ諸国からも支持されていると説明していた。

イランは１１日、外相会議への出席を発表。オマーンは同会議について公式には発表しておらず、他の湾岸諸国もこれまでのところ沈黙を保っている。バーレーンは１２日、会議には出席しないと明らかにした。

前出のイラン高官によると、会議はオマーンが提案。イランは依然、ホルムズ海峡を利用する船舶から通航料を徴収することを認める合意を求めているが、オマーンはこれを拒否しているという。

先週、米国とイランが相次いで同海峡を航行するタンカーを攻撃し、さらにイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が紅海に通じる中東のもう一つの原油輸送の要衝、バベルマンデブ海峡周辺で支配地域を広げたことを受けて、原油価格は急騰したnL6N4530OJ。

一方、イランのタスニム通信は１２日、同国の関係筋の話として、イランとオマーン間の「合意」について報じ、ホルムズ海峡の即時再開を規定するものではないが、同海峡を再開するための基礎作りになるとした。イランによる同海峡への主権行使に向けた一歩となるものだが、海峡の再開は米国がイラン側の条件に応じるか次第だと伝えている。

item.title: Speculators turn net long on yen for first time since February
item.description: Speculators turned to a net long position on the yen for the first time since February, data showed late on Friday, a display of growing momentum behind Japan's beleaguered currency.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift
item.content:encoded: Speculators turned to a net long position on the [USN:L1N44W09D TEXT:"yen"] for the first time since February, data showed late on Friday, a display of growing momentum behind Japan's beleaguered [USN:L4N451055 TEXT:"currency"]. Yen futures data from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission showed net non-commercial positions amounting to 10,796 long contracts in the week to September 8. That is a reversal from net shorts of 92,227 for the week prior and the first overall long reading since February 24. The yen has surged this month on expectations for an accelerated schedule of [USN:L8N4520DS TEXT:"rate hikes"] by the Bank of Japan and a potential [USN:L6N44U1FN TEXT:"repatriation"] of assets by local investors. The dollar-yen rate reached 152.89 on September 8, the strongest level for the currency since February 17. A years-long weakening trend for the yen accelerated with the election of [USN:L4N44W0H7 TEXT:"fiscal dove"] Sanae Takaichi as prime minister last October and a sense that the BOJ was behind the curve in [USN:L4N44Z01M TEXT:"tightening"] monetary policy. The yen slid to a four-decade low of 163.99 per dollar in July before a market [USN:L4N45003O TEXT:"intervention"] by Tokyo and Washington to bolster the currency.

item.title: Republican senator's TV interview passes muster with FCC's Carr even though Democratic candidate's does not
item.description: An ESPN interview on Saturday with a Republican U.S. senator did not violate the Federal Communications Commission's equal-time rule, FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said, days after the agency issued a warning to another network about a Democratic political candidate's appearance on a late-night TV program.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: An ESPN interview on Saturday with a Republican U.S. senator did not violate the Federal Communications Commission's equal-time rule, FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said, days after the agency issued a warning to another network about a Democratic political candidate's appearance on a late-night TV program. Responding to a social media post by a group of college Democrats, Carr wrote that equal-time rules, which require TV networks to give airtime to opposing candidates, do not apply to Senator Ted Cruz's appearance on ESPN's "College GameDay" program because the law applies to broadcast TV stations, not cable programs. Additionally, the statute only applies to legally qualified candidates, which Cruz is not, he said. Cruz, a Texas Republican, is not a candidate in this year's midterm elections. ESPN did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Carr's post came days after his agency warned one of ESPN's sister networks, ABC, over late-night TV host Jimmy Kimmel's interview with James Talarico, a Democratic candidate for Texas' other U.S. Senate seat. "Congress wanted to ensure that voters would decide elections, not media gatekeepers picking winners and losers by providing preferential airtime to some candidates and not others," Carr wrote on Saturday. Kimmel on Thursday aired his interview with [USN:L6N40L1C8 TEXT:"Talarico"] on YouTube rather than on his network broadcast, citing the FCC threat. Talarico is running against Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, a Republican, in a race that could decide control of the U.S. Senate in November. In January, the Republican-led FCC said daytime and late-night TV talk shows are no longer considered "bona fide" news programs that are exempt from equal-time rules. Cruz earlier this year criticized an [USN:L6N41B177 TEXT:"FCC decision to review"] broadcast licenses held by Walt Disney, the parent company of ABC and ESPN. "It is not government's job to censor speech and I do not believe the FCC should operate as the speech police," he told Punchbowl News in comments confirmed by his office.

item.title: Brewers erupt again with 13 runs in win over Reds
item.description: Garrett Mitchell's bat remained scorching hot as the Milwaukee center fielder went 4-for-5 with four RBIs, helping the host Brewers break a record Saturday as they defeated the Cincinnati Reds 13-9.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Garrett Mitchell's bat remained scorching hot as the Milwaukee center fielder went 4-for-5 with four RBIs, helping the host Brewers break a record Saturday as they defeated the Cincinnati Reds 13-9. Combined with their 20-0 pummeling of the Reds on Friday, the 33 runs over two games set a new all-time high for the Brewers (93-56), surpassing the 32 they scored on July 8 and 11, 1990. Saturday was a night for hitters in Milwaukee, with the roof open at American Family Field and the wind blowing out to center, and both teams reaped the benefits. However, the Brewers broke a 5-5 game open with eight straight runs through the fourth and fifth innings to extend their winning streak to five. Mitchell, who went 3-for-5 with a grand slam Friday, got all four hits in the first five innings, with a two-run homer, his 11th of the season, in the first, and a two-run double that capped a five-run fifth. Cooper Pratt doubled while going 3-for-5, while Brice Turang (2-for-4) and William Contreras also homered in the win. Juan Brito (3-for-4) hit his second home run and drove in three for the Reds (69-79), who lost their fifth straight. Eugenio Suarez hit his 23rd home run as part of a 3-for-4 night with three runs scored and two RBIs, and JJ Bleday broke an 0-for-20 streak with a 2-for-5 performance that included two runs scored and an RBI. Elly De La Cruz had a pair of doubles, going 2-for-5, and drove in a run for the Reds. Jake Bauers (1-for-4) also drove in two for the Brewers. Chad Patrick (9-4) struck out four in 1 1/3 innings while allowing just a hit, relieving Brewers starter Shane Drohan, who could not keep a 4-0 lead and allowed five runs on five hits in 3 2/3 innings. Brady Singer (6-14) tied a career-worst by giving up eight runs over four innings. The Reds starter gave up Turang's 19th homer, a two-run shot, and Mitchell's blast as the Brewers led 4-0 after the first inning. After the Reds tied the game in the top of the fourth, Singer gave up a three-run shot to Contreras, his 17th of the season. --Field Level Media

item.title: C.J. Stroud, Texans reportedly table contract talks for 2026
item.description: Barring a last-minute breakthrough in negotiations, Houston Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud will play this season without a new contract, according to multiple reports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Barring a last-minute breakthrough in negotiations, Houston Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud will play this season without a new contract, according to multiple reports. Texans general manager Nick Caserio said the front office wouldn't discuss a new deal during the regular season, which begins Sunday against the Buffalo Bills. ESPN reported Saturday that Stroud, the No. 2 overall pick in 2023, made an effort through his agent to progress toward an extension. He was selected one spot ahead of Texans outside linebacker Will Anderson Jr. The Texans signed Anderson to a three-year, $150 million extension days before the 2026 NFL Draft. Entering the fourth year of his four-year deal, Stroud also is under contract through 2027 due to the team option being picked up by the Texans in April. He's guaranteed $25.9 million for next season. "We've had productive discussions, I would say," Caserio said at the end of training camp. "And the reality is, will either get it figured out before the season starts, and if we don't get it figured out before the season starts, then there's something we address in the offseason. So, you know, whenever it happens, it happens." Stroud had 3,041 passing yards, 19 touchdowns and eight interceptions in the 2025 regular season and missed three games due to a concussion. His playoff performance created doubt about his place in the upper-echelon of NFL quarterbacks in some circles, but head coach DeMeco Ryans declared his loyalty to Stroud in the offseason. The AFC champion Patriots intercepted Stroud four times in the first half of the AFC divisional playoff matchup in January. He had seven turnovers in two playoff games. Several prominent quarterbacks are set to enter contract talks in the next several months, including Lamar Jackson (Ravens), Caleb Williams (Bears) and Drake Maye (Patriots). Stroud, who turns 25 in October, hasn't publicly discussed the contract matter since July 29 at the start of training camp, saying he would leave the business side to his agent, David Mulugheta. Caserio said if a deal wasn't done by Sunday, it would become "something we address in the offseason." --Field Level Media

item.title: New report of attack on Strait of Hormuz shipping fans fears of threats to oil supplies
item.description: Maritime trackers received new reports of an attack on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, adding to concerns about Iran-related threats to global energy supplies after Saudi Arabia shut down a vital oil pipeline.
item.dc:creator: Mohammed Ghobari, Eman Abouhassira, Yasmine Ghania
item.content:encoded: Maritime trackers received new reports of an attack on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, adding to concerns about Iran-related threats to global energy supplies after Saudi Arabia shut down a vital oil pipeline. The British navy-affiliated agency UKMTO said it had a report of a projectile hitting a vessel as it moved through the strait. The amount of damage and the status of the crew were unknown as of early Sunday, the agency said. UKMTO's report came the day after Saudi Arabia said it had temporarily closed its East-West pipeline as a precaution after a drone attack that both Baghdad and Riyadh said had originated in Iraq, where Iranian-backed militias operate. Ongoing attacks in the widening Middle East war could send energy prices even higher after a week that saw the cost of Brent crude surge back above $100 a barrel. The 1,200-km (745-mile) East-West pipeline running across the Arabian Peninsula has served as the main route out for global supplies of Middle East oil for the past six months while [USN:L1N453039 TEXT:"the Strait of Hormuz has been largely shut"] by war. It has been moving 4 million to 5 million barrels per day, amounting to 4% to 5% of global supply, sparing Saudi Arabia the brunt of the disruption that has crippled other Gulf oil and gas exporters. There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the strikes on the pipeline. Satellite images showed black smoke rising from an area of the pipeline south of Medina. The attack resulted in some injuries and damage that was being assessed, the Saudi Foreign Ministry said without detailing the impact on exports. U.S. President Donald Trump, visiting Ireland to attend a golf tournament at one of his resorts, said [USN:S8N42A04U TEXT:"Iran was probably to blame"]. On Saturday, Saudi Civil Defence said in a statement that a projectile fired by the Houthis had injured two people in Jazan region, and damaged several buildings, including a mosque. Iranian state media reported an Iranian commercial vessel was struck off its southern coast early on Sunday, killing one person and wounding three others, without giving further details. SAUDI LEADER ASKS FOR U.S. MILITARY HELP Oil prices shot up over the past week and the retail price of diesel in the United States surged [USN:L1N45211Q TEXT:"past a record $6 a gallon"] as the United States and Iran both fired on tankers and the Houthis in Yemen rapidly advanced along the Red Sea, potentially giving Tehran leverage over both of the region's main oil-shipping corridors. Washington now faces a dilemma over [USN:L6N453163 TEXT:"whether to help the Saudis fight the Houthis"], risking further expansion of the war. Saudi Arabia's de facto ruler, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, [USN:L6N45308G TEXT:"phoned Trump"] on Thursday and asked for U.S. military help fighting the Houthis, three sources told Reuters. They said the prince was told that Washington would not intervene directly for now but would help with intelligence. Trump confirmed on Saturday that he had spoken to the crown prince, and said the Houthis had also phoned his administration and asked Washington not to become directly involved in the conflict. Four Yemeni government sources told Reuters that the Houthis had seized the strategic island of Perim on Friday in the middle of the Bab el-Mandeb strait — the "Gate of Tears" at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. The Houthis have been attacking Saudi ships in the area since declaring a blockade in July and targeting its other oil facilities. IRANIAN OFFICIAL PLAYS DOWN OMAN MEETING There have been no talks between the United States and Iran to end the conflict since a June agreement that collapsed within weeks. In a post on X on Saturday, Ebrahim Azizi, head of the Iranian parliament's national security committee, said: "As long as the American side does not accept all of Iran's conditions, dialogue and negotiation are of no use." Iran's Foreign Ministry announced on Friday that Iran would be attending a meeting with Gulf Arab states in Oman on Monday, at which the future of the Strait of Hormuz would be discussed. But a senior Iranian official, speaking to Reuters on condition of anonymity on Saturday, played down the chances of a breakthrough, saying the meeting, called at Oman's initiative, was intended to discuss issues including the strait but was not expected to yield a signed agreement. An agreement on routes through the strait between Iran and Oman will be presented at the meeting on Monday, but the strait will not reopen unless seven conditions conveyed by Iran to the U.S. are met, a source told Tasnim news agency, without elaborating. Iran wants its control of the Strait of Hormuz to be recognised, allowing it to collect fees from ships that use it, which Washington rejects. Oman, which controls the opposite bank of the strait, says it is negotiating with the agreement of other regional states. Ships had free and open passage through the strait before the war began.

item.title: Top 25 roundup: Oklahoma State stuns No. 6 Oregon to end skid
item.description: Drew Mestemaker passed for 317 yards with a pair of touchdowns, and added 109 rushing yards with a touchdown to lead Oklahoma State to a stunning 39-31 upset of No. 6 Oregon in a weather-delayed game in Stillwater, Okla. on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Drew Mestemaker passed for 317 yards with a pair of touchdowns, and added 109 rushing yards with a touchdown to lead Oklahoma State to a stunning 39-31 upset of No. 6 Oregon in a weather-delayed game in Stillwater, Okla. on Saturday afternoon. The Cowboys (1-1) put up 554 yards of total offense, with Caleb Hawkins adding 110 rushing yards on 23 carries to go with a score. Oregon (1-1) rallied from a 10-point deficit early in the second half to take a 31-30 lead with Dante Moore's 38-yard touchdown pass to Evan Stewart on the second play of the fourth quarter. But the Ducks' defense couldn't hold the lead -- with Mestemaker putting the Cowboys ahead for good on a 10-yard scoring run -- and the Oregon offense didn't score another point. The final blow was a lost fumble by running back Dierre Hill Jr. with 1:55 left that cost Oregon a final chance to tie the game. Oregon led 7-3 in the early going on Devon Jackson's 96-yard interception return for a touchdown. But the Ducks managed just 281 yards of offense and saw their 12-game road winning streak snapped. No. 2 Georgia 70, Western Kentucky 20 Gunner Stockton completed 13 of 16 passes for 234 yards and a program-record-tying five touchdowns to help the Bulldogs dispatch of the Hilltoppers in Athens, Ga. Backup quarterback Ryan Puglisi rushed for a 70-yard touchdown for Georgia (2-0), which has outscored its first two opponents by a combined score of 133-23. Tyriq Green scored twice for the Bulldogs, recovering a fumble in the end zone and returning a 91-yard kickoff. Georgia scored on its first seven possessions. Rodney Tisdale Jr. threw for 31 yards for Western Kentucky (0-2) before Brock Glenn took over under center, who had a passing touchdown and two rushing touchdowns in a relief effort despite the Hilltoppers being outgained 493-225. No. 3 Notre Dame 52, Rice 0 CJ Carr completed 16 of 20 passes for 253 yards and four touchdowns and the Fighting Irish crushed the Owls in South Bend, Ind. Jordan Faison caught two touchdown passes for Notre Dame (2-0), which was playing its home opener after facing Wisconsin at Green Bay's Lambeau Field six days earlier. Nolan James Jr. added two touchdowns on the ground. Jacurri Brown completed 8 of 12 passes for 64 yards to lead Rice (1-1). Brown also had a team-high 32 rushing yards for the Owls. Notre Dame outgained Rice 478-128, including a 360-64 advantage in passing yards, and had four takeaways without turning the ball over. No. 5 Indiana 55, Howard 0 Josh Hoover connected with Charlie Becker for three touchdowns in the first half to spark the Hoosiers past the Bison in Bloomington, Ind. -- Indiana's first game against an HBCU opponent in program history. Hoover finished 6 of 11 for 146 yards and four scores before taking a seat for the second half. Becker, who scored on all three of his touches, also rested after halftime as he pushed his season touchdown total to five. Lee Beebe Jr. (16 carries, 112 yards) and Turbo Richard (11 carries, 108 yards) earned their first 100-yard games for Indiana (2-0). Ja'Shawn Scroggins completed 8 of 15 passes for 43 yards and one interception for Howard (1-2) before being replaced in the second half by Isaiah Freeman. No. 10 Texas A&M 48, Arizona State 20 Marcel Reed tossed three touchdown passes while Marco Jones and Julio Humphrey returned interceptions for touchdowns to help the No. 10 Aggies beat the Sun Devils in College Station, Texas. Isaiah Horton caught two touchdown passes, Mario Craver also grabbed one and Rueben Owens II scored on the ground for Texas A&M (2-0), which forced four turnovers. Reed completed 15 of 25 passes for 163 yards and was intercepted once for the Aggies. Cutter Boley was 21-of-34 passing for 254 yards, two touchdowns and the two costly interceptions for Arizona State (1-1). Boley threw for six touchdowns against Morgan State in Week 1 in his Sun Devils debut after transferring from Kentucky. Michigan 17, No. 11 Oklahoma 10 Bryce Underwood threw for 111 yards and ran for 87 yards and a touchdown as the host Wolverines upset the Sooners in Ann Arbor, Mich., a week after Michigan needed a controversial Hail Mary on the final play to beat Western Michigan. After forcing Michigan to punt, the Sooners took possession on their own 15 with 1:06 remaining and no timeouts while trailing by seven. Oklahoma quarterback John Mateer broke off a 22-yard gain to open the drive, then nearly connected with Rocky Beers to get deep in Michigan territory two plays later. But after Chase Taylor broke up that pass, Nate Marshall sacked Mateer on the next play, and time expired before the Sooners could get off another play. No. 12 Alabama 45, Kentucky 17 Daniel Hill ran for a career-high 104 yards to help the Crimson Tide overcome three first-half turnovers and run away from the Wildcats in their Southeastern Conference opener in Lexington, Ky. Hill, Trae'shawn Brown and EJ Crowell each scored on the ground for Alabama, which finished with 155 rushing yards -- 150 of which came after halftime. Keelon Russell threw for 188 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in his first road start for the Crimson Tide (2-0, 1-0 SEC), who outscored Kentucky 32-0 in the second half. Kenny Minchey completed 18 of 31 passes for 146 yards, a touchdown and an interception for the Wildcats (1-1, 0-1), who managed just 62 yards of offense after halftime. Will Stein became the ninth straight Kentucky coach to lose his first SEC game. No. 15 BYU 28, Arizona 17 Bear Bachmeier threw for three touchdowns and ran for another as the host Cougars rallied past the Wildcats in Provo, Utah. Bachmeier went 16 of 26 for 217 yards and three touchdowns -- two caught by Kyler Kasper in the second half -- and added 37 rushing yards with the score. LJ Martin ran for 98 yards, including 73 in the second half as the Cougars (2-0, 1-0 Big 12) shut Arizona out in the second half. Arizona (1-1, 0-1) got 268 yards of total offense from Noah Fifita, who threw for 230 yards and one touchdown and ran for 38 yards and a score. No. 16 Penn State 27, Temple 9 Rocco Becht threw for 268 yards and three touchdowns to guide the Nittany Lions to a road win over the Owls in Philadelphia. Becht went 21 of 27 on the day, including five completions to Benjamin Brahmer, who racked up 79 yards and two touchdowns. Chase Sowell also caught a TD pass for Penn State (2-0), while Carson Hansen chipped in with 84 yards on 19 carries. Temple's Jaxon Smolik, who previously played for the Nittany Lions, completed 10-of-16 passes for 59 yards with an interception. He also added 71 rushing yards for Temple (1-1), while Keveun Mason rushed 14 times for 76 yards. No. 17 SMU 56, UC Davis 10 Kevin Jennings passed for 337 yards and five touchdowns, all in the first half, leading the Mustangs to a runaway win over the Aggies in Dallas. Jennings completed 14 of 16 passes without a turnover, throwing touchdown passes to four different receivers. Yamir Knight caught three passes for 62 yards, Derrick McFall added two receptions for 57 yards and a score, and Theo Melin Ohrstrom caught three passes for 25 yards and two touchdowns for SMU (2-0), which won its second game in a six-day span. UC Davis (2-1) starting quarterback Treynor Cleeland was 11-for-26 passing for 83 yards with one interception. Jackson Kollock replaced him and completed eight of 10 passes for 88 yards and a touchdown. No. 19 Washington State 16, Utah State 14 Tyler Robles kicked three field goals and the Huskies held on for a nonconference victory against the Aggies in Seattle. Utah State's Grady Brosterhous threw a 7-yard touchdown pass to Eli Wood with 1:50 remaining. Washington (2-0) recovered the ensuing onside kick but couldn't run out the clock. The Aggies (0-2) got the ball back on their 15-yard line with 46 seconds left and no timeouts remaining, but a last-second Hail Mary into the end zone was intercepted by Rahshawn Clark. The Huskies' Demond Williams Jr. completed 26 of 41 passes for 249 yards and rushed for a team-high 56 yards on 11 carries. Brosterhous, a transfer from Virginia, started in place of McCae Hillstead, who suffered a forearm injury in a season-opening loss to Idaho State. Brosterhous completed 17 of 28 passes for 196 yards and two TDs and rushed for a game-high 81 yards on 21 carries. --Field Level Media

item.title: Braves erupt for 8 runs in fourth to overwhelm Phillies
item.description: Michael Harris II and Ronald Acuna Jr. each homered and right-hander Tyler Mahle produced another strong start to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 12-2 win over the visiting Philadelphia Phillies on Saturday night, clinching the three-game series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Michael Harris II and Ronald Acuna Jr. each homered and right-hander Tyler Mahle produced another strong start to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 12-2 win over the visiting Philadelphia Phillies on Saturday night, clinching the three-game series. The Braves (88-61) now hold a six-game lead over two-time division champion Philadelphia (82-67) in the National League East. Atlanta reduced its magic number to win the division to seven games. The Braves are 9-3 against the Phillies. Harris was 4-for-5 with a three-run homer, his 25th, and two runs. Acuna was 3-for-3 with a home run and a walk, two runs scored and two RBIs. Mahle (6-10) matched his season high by pitching seven innings and allowed one run on six hits with three strikeouts. He has a 1.25 ERA in seven starts since joining Atlanta. Tim Mayza was Philadelphia's replacement starter for Jesus Luzardo, who had to be skipped because of shoulder soreness. It was the fifth time the left-hander had been used as an opener. He pitched three scoreless innings with two hits and four strikeouts before being lifted. But the five ensuing relievers allowed a combined 11 hits, five walks and 12 runs (six earned). Philadelphia scored a run in the first inning when Bryce Harper hit his 28th homer, a 426-foot solo shot to center field. It was the 391st home run in Harper's career, 48th against Atlanta. The Braves sent 12 batters to the plate in the fourth inning and scored eight times to seize the momentum. Atlanta tied the game 1-1 on a solo shot by Acuna, his 17th, off Brooks Raley (5-7), who took the loss. The Braves tacked on two more runs when Mauricio Dubon lined a two-run single to left field off reliever Grant Holman. They added another run on third baseman Bryson Stott's throwing error, Drake Baldwin followed with a two-run double and Acuna completed the uprising with an RBI single to center. Justin Crawford hit a solo homer, his third, for Philadelphia in the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: One dead, more than 30 missing after Vanuatu ferry sinks, PM's office says
item.description: At least one person was confirmed dead and more than 30 were missing on Sunday after a ferry sank off Vanuatu's coast, Prime Minister Jotham Napat's office said in a statement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least one person was confirmed dead and more than 30 were missing on Sunday after a ferry sank off Vanuatu's coast, Prime Minister Jotham Napat's office said in a statement. Search and rescue operations were continuing in the Pacific Island nation located about 1,750 km (1,090 miles) east of Australia after the MV Matui went down with dozens of crew and passengers on board, the statement posted on Facebook said. Fifteen of those have been accounted for alive, it added. Search efforts had been underway since the inter-island ferry sank in bad weather on Friday between the islands of Ambae and Santo, according to New Zealand public broadcaster RNZ. Napat's office said the search "in open waters is being eased off whilst efforts move toward a search along the south-east coast, where currents may have carried survivors". "This loss appears to be the result of strong winds and marine warnings not being heeded, and possibly of negligence including overloading of the vessel," the statement said. "To the survivors, we pray for your strength and recovery. To the families of those missing and those we have lost, please know that the nation stands with you in this time of grief," it said, adding that an investigation would be carried out. Matai Seremaiah, representative of the Luganville area in Vanuatu's parliament, said rescue efforts commenced after an MV Matui crew member swam ashore and raised the alarm. "He alerted us that the ship has capsized, we went out for the search," Seremaiah said in remarks broadcast by RNZ. Vanuatu police, the Vanuatu Maritime Safety Authority and the ferry's operator, Tui Shipping Agency, did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: サッカー＝フランクフルトが今季初勝利、堂安フル出場で得点に絡む
item.description: ［ベルリン １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ベルリン　１２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１２日、各地で試合を行い、堂安律と小杉啓太がフル出場したアイントラハト・フランクフルトがマインツを３─１で下し、今季初勝利を挙げた。

フランクフルトはジャン・ウズンらのゴールで前半に２─０とリードすると、後半１５分には右サイドでボールを持った堂安がマリオ・ゲッツェへつなぎ、最後はウズンが押し込んで３点目。チームはその後１点を返されたがリードを守り切った。

マインツの佐野海舟はフル出場し、川崎颯太はベンチ入りしたが、出場はなかった。

鈴木唯人が先発したフライブルクは板倉滉がフル出場したボルシアＭＧに５─０と大勝し、開幕３連勝。前半のうちにイゴール・マタノビッチらが決めて２─０とすると、後半にも同選手を含め３選手が得点を挙げた。鈴木は後半３３分に後藤啓介と交代するまでプレー。山本理仁はベンチ入りしなかった。

ボルシアＭＧの町野修斗は後半頭から出場。橋岡大樹と宇野禅斗はベンチ入りしなかった。

町田浩樹が所属するホッフェンハイムはシュツットガルトに２─１で勝利。町田は後半２４分からピッチに入った。

その他、ドルトムントはパーダーボルンに３─０と快勝し、レーバークーゼンはアウクスブルクと２─２で引き分け。ケルンとブレーメンは１─１のドローに終わった。

item.title: Sylvester Stallone's life is the real Rocky Balboa story, "I Play Rocky" director says
item.description: Sylvester Stallone's life is the real Rocky Balboa story, film director Peter Farrelly said as he walked down the red carpet for the premiere of "I Play Rocky" at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Nivedita Balu
item.content:encoded: Sylvester Stallone's life is the real Rocky Balboa story, film director Peter Farrelly said as he walked down the red carpet for the premiere of "I Play Rocky" at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday. The film brings to the big screen the story behind the making of "Rocky," an underdog story that has inspired many fans of Stallone's fictional character Rocky Balboa's sheer determination. Farrelly aims to present "I Play Rocky" to fans of the fictional Philadelphia boxer, and to a new, younger crowd unfamiliar with Stallone's struggles before he became the star of "Rocky." Stallone wrote and starred in the 1976 film, now a cultural phenomenon. "The Rocky story is actually a true story. Rocky is fiction, but Stallone's story is the Rocky story," Farrelly said. "And the message is: you never give up and you never give in. You can't be bought out. And in this day and age, everybody's bought out, everybody goes for the money. He didn't." Asked if Stallone has watched the movie yet, Farrelly said the 80-year-old watched it alone. "It was nerve-wracking because he (Stallone) saw it alone. And this is a great movie with a crowd. I didn't know how he was going to take it," Farrelly said. "But he loved it. Thank god." Stallone was an obscure actor before pitching the story and stubbornly refused to let studios cast anyone but him in the role. The film was nominated for 10 Oscars and won three. Anthony Ippolito plays Stallone in "I play Rocky", portraying the actor's determination to become an actor and capturing his gravelly voice, muscular physique, while also recreating the iconic scene on Philadelphia's Rocky steps. The film will be brought to theaters by Amazon's (AMZN.O) MGM Studios in the U.S. and by Elevation Pictures in Canada.

item.title: ラグビー＝ＰＮＣで日本が決勝進出、合計9トライで米国に快勝
item.description: ［１２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１２日　ロイター］ - ４カ国で争うラグビーのパシフィック・ネーションズカップ（ＰＮＣ）は１２日、大阪府の東大阪市花園ラグビー場で試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表が同１４位の米国代表に６３─１４で快勝した。

日本は開始２分に広瀬雄也のトライで先制。その後もマイケル・ストーバーグ、ディラン・ライリー、原田衛、大塚壮二郎がトライを決めて、３５─１４のリードで前半を終えた。日本は後半にもライリーのこの日２つ目のトライなど、計４つのトライを奪い、相手を圧倒した。

日本は１９日の決勝では、大会３連覇を狙う世界ランキング９位のフィジーと対戦する。大会最多７回の優勝を誇るフィジーは、準決勝で同２４位のカナダを４５─２９で下した。

item.title: Rays squeeze out another win over Astros
item.description: Pinch hitter Nick Madrigal produced a tiebreaking sacrifice fly, Bryan Baker recorded his major league-leading 40th save and the first-place Tampa Bay Rays padded their American League East lead with a 3-2 win over the Houston Astros on Saturday night in St. Petersburg, Fla.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Pinch hitter Nick Madrigal produced a tiebreaking sacrifice fly, Bryan Baker recorded his major league-leading 40th save and the first-place Tampa Bay Rays padded their American League East lead with a 3-2 win over the Houston Astros on Saturday night in St. Petersburg, Fla. Richie Palacios had a single and two RBIs while Victor Mesa singled, scored and walked twice as Tampa Bay (89-59) stretched its lead over the New York Yankees to four games. Starter Ian Seymour had a dominant stretch after allowing a run in the first inning but failed to win in his sixth straight appearance, five of them starts. The left-hander finished with two runs allowed on four hits over six innings. He whiffed 10 and walked one. Tyler Wells (5-2) followed Seymour with a scoreless seventh. Playing their second straight night without star hitter Yordan Alvarez, the Astros (75-74) saw Yainer Diaz get three of the club's five hits and post an RBI. Isaac Paredes socked a solo homer. Peter Lambert (8-9) tossed six-plus innings and gave up three runs on six hits. He struck out four with no walks. Paredes began the middle game the same way Junior Caminero walked off the opener -- with a homer to left center. He rocked his 20th homer off Seymour's 1-0 sweeper in the first inning. Lambert breezed through the Rays' lineup over the first four frames by striking out three and yielding only Caminero's first-inning single. Seymour settled in and retired 14 straight Astros after Diaz singled in the first, which included fanning the side in the fifth. The Rays' offense finally got to Lambert in the home half of the fifth behind singles from Mesa and Chandler Simpson. Palacios followed by lashing a single to center to go up 2-1. Houston snapped Seymour's run of 16 straight batters when Jose Altuve hit a two-out double in the sixth. He came home on Diaz's second hit, an RBI single that made it 2-2. In the seventh, Madrigal managed a sacrifice fly that scored pinch runner Kenny Piper for Tampa Bay's second lead. Baker clinched the series win for the Rays by producing a four-out save, capped by Taylor Trammell's flyout to the wall in right. --Field Level Media

item.title: オープンＡＩのＣＥＯ、年内ＩＰＯを否定 米誌インタビューで
item.description:
Lisa Baertlein
[ロサンゼルス １２日 ロイター] - 対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がけ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩのＣＥＯ、年内ＩＰＯを否定　米誌インタビューで 10:18 配信

写真はオープンＡＩのアルトマンＣＥＯ。2026年7月29日撮影。REUTERS/Anna Rose Layden

Lisa Baertlein

[ロサンゼルス １２日 ロイター] - 対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がけるオープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１２日付の米経済誌フォーチュン掲載のインタビューで、２０２６年中の上場はないと言明した。ＡＩに関する安全上の懸念を理由に挙げた。

「安全性の面で起きているあらゆる状況を踏まえると、現時点で上場するのは賢明ではないと考えており、その点についてプレッシャーも感じていない」と語った。

オープンＡＩと競合する米アンソロピックの研究者２人が、ＡＩが急速に進歩して、そう遠くない将来に人類滅亡につながりかねないと警告したことを受け、米議会の議員の間でＡＩシステムを規制する新たなルールを求める声が高まっている。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズは６月、オープンＡＩが新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を来年まで延期することを検討していると報じていた。

アルトマン氏はインタビューで、ＩＰＯを２６年から２７年に先送りするのか問われ「２６年ではないだろう。今後の安全性や連携のために今何をすべきか、また業界と政府がどのように協力できるかといった課題など、やるべきことは山積みだ」と述べた。

同氏はまた、オープンＡＩやその他の主要ＡＩ企業が、ＡＩ開発のペースを緩め、安全上のリスクに対処するために協力する内容の合意を発表する段階に近いことを示唆したという。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：クック氏からターナス氏へ、アップル新体制にＡＩと「脱中国」の試練 アングル：中銀の政策運営、ＡＩ普及で「ディストピア」に直面の恐れ　研究者が警鐘 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど アングル：ＡＩエージェントの「暴走リスク」現実に、見直し迫られるサイバー保険 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 最終更新: 9/13(日) 10:18 ロイター

item.title: アンソロピックＣＥＯ、ＡＩ開発の減速訴え ネット乗っ取りの可能性警告
item.description:
Anusha Shah
[１２日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＣＥＯ、ＡＩ開発の減速訴え　ネット乗っ取りの可能性警告 10:15 配信

写真はアンソロピックのアモデイＣＥＯ。2026年2月19日、インドのニューデリーで撮影。REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra

Anusha Shah

[１２日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１２日、Ｘに掲載した文書で「われわれはＡＩモデルの能力を向上させるペースを緩めなければならない」と主張し、ＡＩ業界全体に開発を減速するよう促した。

ＡＩが自律的に能力を向上させることで人間の制御が難しくなるとの懸念がかねてからあることや、同業オープンＡＩの自律型エージェントがＡＩ新興ハギングフェイスに不正侵入した事案に言及。「ＡＩ能力の開発ペースが加速していることを踏まえると、６─１２カ月以内にＡＩの集団がインターネット全体を乗っ取り、数千億ドルの損害をもたらす可能性がある」と警告した。

ＡＩ開発企業ｘＡＩを率いるイーロン・マスク氏とオープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯはともに、Ｘへの投稿でアモデイ氏の見解に同意すると述べた。

アモデイ氏は、各企業が安全対策の検証のために従業員と同等のアクセス権を持つ独立した評価者を組織内に配置し、最先端ＡＩ企業間で連携して安全基準を設定するとともに無秩序なＡＩ開発を制限するほか、ＡＩ関連リスクを管理するための国際協力を行うという３段階のアプローチを提案した。

アルトマン氏は従業員と同等のアクセス権を持つ独立した評価者の配置について「われわれも同様の措置を講じる」と述べ、詳細を近く明らかにする考えを示した。

アモデイ氏はさらに、米国の主要ＡＩ企業は協調することで、競争上の不利益を被ることなく安全対策を講じられると説明。特定の分野での協力を可能にするため、米国において独占禁止法の対象を絞った適用除外措置が必要になる可能性が高いとの見解を示した。

同時に、民主主義国家における開発減速は、米国のＡＩ企業が中国をはじめとする権威主義的な体制に対して有する優位性を維持する程度に限定されるべきだとも述べた。ＡＩ分野で中国が優位性を有することになれば米国の国家安全保障上のリスクとなると主張した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ムスリム候補者をやり玉に、米中間選挙でイスラム教を争点化する共和党 アングル：フォードの中国企業提携巡る毀誉褒貶、米政権のちぐはぐ対応が鮮明に 焦点：ウクライナ軍新司令部に初試練、東部ドネツクでロシアが攻勢の秋 アングル：韓国半導体大手2社の巨額還元、「コリア・ディスカウント」是正の試金石 アングル：アップル初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ、強気価格が突きつける「誰のためのスマホか」 最終更新: 9/13(日) 10:15 ロイター

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース、ベッツ弾でＬＡ移転後1万ＨＲ到達─ＭＬＢ公式
item.description: ［１２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースは１２日のマーリンズ戦で、ロサンゼルスに移転した１９５８年以来、通算１万本目の本塁打を記録した。ＭＬＢ公式サイトが報じている。

ドジャースは初回に３番ムーキー・ベッツ遊撃手が左中間に運び、今季２０号ソロをマークした。さらに４番マックス・マンシー三塁手が２８号ソロで続き、２者連続本塁打とした。ドジャースは今季１８３本塁打で、チームトップは大谷翔平選手の３０本。

ドジャースは３─４の逆転負けを喫し、連勝は８で止まった。

item.title: Les Suédois aux urnes pour des législatives qui s'annoncent serrées
item.description: Les Suédois sont appelés aux urnes dimanche pour des élections législatives qui s'annoncent serrées, alors que l'opposition de centre-gauche est créditée d'une légère avance sur le bloc de droite au pouvoir.
item.dc:creator: Simon Johnson, Niklas Pollard
item.content:encoded: Les Suédois sont appelés aux urnes dimanche pour des élections législatives qui s'annoncent serrées, alors que l'opposition de centre-gauche est créditée d'une légère avance sur le bloc de droite au pouvoir. Le Premier ministre conservateur Ulf Kristersson a toutefois gagné du terrain sur son adversaire, la dirigeante des sociaux-démocrates Magdalena Andersson, dans les dernières semaines de la campagne électorale. Les partisans de la coalition de droite estiment que ses politiques ont permis de faire freiner de manière significative la violence des gangs et l'immigration. "Nous pouvons rassembler les partis, les électeurs et les enjeux autour d'une action commune. C'est pour cela que nous obtenons des résultats", a dit Ulf Kristersson cette semaine. En quête d'un deuxième mandat consécutif, Ulf Kristersson, chef du Parti des Modérés (conservateur), a promis d'offrir des ministères au parti de Jimmie Akesson, Démocrates de Suède, une formation anti-immigration plongeant ses racines dans la mouvance néo-nazie. Ses détracteurs rétorquent que ce programme porte atteinte aux libertés civiles tout en contraignant les immigrés à se conformer davantage aux normes culturelles suédoises ou à quitter le pays. "Nous sommes devenus une société plus dure, plus silencieuse, mais aussi plus pauvre, car notre croissance est restée bien en deçà de notre potentiel et les ménages voient leur pouvoir d'achat diminuer de plus en plus", a dit Ulf Andersson à Reuters. "Notre pays a fondé sa force sur le partage des réussites de chacun et sur le fait que nous restons solidaires lorsque les temps sont durs." Les bureaux de vote ouvriront leurs portes à 08h00 du matin (06hGMT) et fermeront à 18h00 GMT. Les sondages de sortie des urnes sont attendus peu après.

item.title: テニス＝全米ＯＰ車いす、女子の上地が2連覇 男子の小田は準優勝
item.description: ［１２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１２日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）は１２日、車いすの部の決勝を行い、女子シングルスでは第１シードの上地結衣が大会２連覇を果たした。

上地は第２シードのディーデ・デフロート（オランダ）に６─２、１─６、６─３で勝利。１時間４１分の熱戦を制し、同大会４回目の優勝を達成した。

男子では、第１シードの小田凱人が第２シードのシードのアルフィー・ヒューエット（英国）に０─６、６─７で敗れて準優勝。大会２連覇を逃し、１シーズンでの四大大会全制覇、「年間グランドスラム」を達成することはできなかった。

item.title: Australia vows to bolster resilience of telco networks after Optus outage
item.description: Australia's government pledged on Sunday to bolster resilience in the nation's telecommunications networks after an outage at Optus, the country's No. 2 carrier, impacted users in three states and disrupted some emergency services calls.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's government pledged on Sunday to bolster resilience in the nation's telecommunications networks after an outage at Optus, the country's No. 2 carrier, impacted users in three states and disrupted some emergency services calls. The 76-minute technical glitch on Friday affected Optus voice calling services in parts of Victoria, South Australia, Tasmania states and the Northern Territory, with some customers experiencing "intermittent call dropouts", according to Optus. It followed an Optus [USN:L3N3V800U TEXT:"network issue"] last year that left hundreds of people unable to contact police, fire and ambulance services and resulted in two deaths. Asked on Sunday about the latest outage, Communications Minister Anika Wells said "no piece of infrastructure be it roads, bridges, poles, wires is 100% resilient". "What we need to do is make sure these systems are as resilient as we can possibly make them," Wells said in televised remarks. Optus, owned by Singapore Telecommunications (STEL.SI) , on Saturday [USN:L4N454020 TEXT:"apologised"] for the glitch, which the centre-left government described as "deeply concerning" and said was being investigated. In 2024, Optus was fined A$12 million by regulators for failing to provide emergency call services to thousands during a nationwide outage in 2023. Optus also suffered a cyberattack in 2022 that affected the data of around 9.5 million Australians.

item.title: South Africa felt series against All Blacks in the balance until close to the end
item.description: South Africa felt their tour series against New Zealand was in the balance up until the final 10 minutes of the last test, before they went on to register a 43-28 win and secure the trophy 3-1.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Africa felt their tour series against New Zealand was in the balance up until the final 10 minutes of the last test, before they went on to register a [USN:L6N45408Z TEXT:"43-28 win "]and secure the trophy 3-1. Coach Rassie Erasmus said he was not confident of victory until the last stages of the final clash, staged in the United States on Saturday. New Zealand had won the opening test in Johannesburg last month in a blistering start to the six-week tour, but the world champion Springboks bounced back to win the next two games and make sure they could not lose the series. But an All Blacks victory in Baltimore would have made it 2-2 and seen the spoils shared, and New Zealand fought back strongly in the second half. “In minute 70, I thought it was still in the balance. In the end, we came out winners because we had more points on the board, and that's probably the most important thing,” he told the post-match press conference. “Although you have different things that you're trying to do, build your game, get your attacks going, and defend better, but it's all about the scoreboard, and up until the last 10 minutes, I wasn't sure we were going to win.” South Africa had a narrow 17-14 lead at halftime but stretched that with two quick tries in the second half, only for New Zealand to fight back and reduce the deficit to eight points before a superb individual try by Bok winger Kurt-Lee Arendse allowed them breathing space. “We appreciate that we won, but we definitely don't think the margin between us and New Zealand is big,” Erasmus added. The South African camp praised the support received from the 68,000-strong crowd. The decision to take the last test of “Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry” to the U.S was designed to fill the coffers of the two unions who share the profits of the tour, the first of its kind in 30 years and now scheduled to be played every four years. “It was super special. It was crazy the amount of people who came out to support us,” said Springbok captain Siya Kolisi. “We're hoping that the game grows here, because we know that the (2031) World Cup is going to be here,” he added.

item.title: Fachin assume relatoria de caso sobre relações de Moraes com Vorcaro
item.description: O presidente do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), Edson Fachin, chamou para si a relatoria da petição sobre as mensagens trocadas entre o ministro Alexandre de Moraes e o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, do Banco Master, que irá a julgamento no plenário da corte na próxima terça-feira, segundo decisão proferida por ele na noite deste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), Edson Fachin, chamou para si a relatoria da petição sobre as mensagens trocadas entre o ministro Alexandre de Moraes e o banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, do Banco Master, que irá a julgamento no plenário da corte na próxima terça-feira, segundo decisão proferida por ele na noite deste sábado. Com a decisão, o ministro André Mendonça deixa a relatoria do caso, que pode levar à abertura de uma investigação contra Moraes. "Determino... à Secretaria Judiciária que substitua a relatoria da PET 16.662 (que trata de Moraes) para a presidência do Supremo Tribunal Federal", escreveu o ministro na decisão. Mais cedo neste sábado, Fachin rejeitou o pedido de Moraes para que a petição sobre ele fosse analisada juntamente com uma petição sobre Mendonça, que pode levar à investigação do ministro. Moraes apontou que o colega teria cometido abuso de autoridade e crime de responsabilidade por alegadamente ter direcionado investigações contra ele. Fachin manteve a análise da petição sobre Moraes na próxima terça-feira e marcou para o dia 23 o julgamento da petição sobre Mendonça.
