item.title: US Open women's singles champion Elena Rybakina
item.description: Factbox on Elena Rybakina, who beat Belarusian top seed Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2 in the U.S. Open final to win her third Grand Slam title on Saturday:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Factbox on Elena Rybakina, who beat Belarusian top seed Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2 in the U.S. Open final to win her third Grand Slam title on Saturday: Age: 27 Nation: Kazakhstan WTA ranking: 2 Seeding: 2 Grand Slam titles: 3 (Wimbledon 2022, Australian Open 2026, U.S. Open 2026) EARLY LIFE * Began playing tennis at the age of six. * Born in Moscow, Rybakina switched allegiance to Kazakhstan in 2018. CAREER TO DATE * Began her professional career on the ITF Circuit in 2014. * Won two ITF doubles titles in 2017, followed by one singles and one doubles title in 2018. * Claimed her maiden WTA title in Bucharest in 2019, beating Patricia Maria Tig in the final, and broke into the top 50. * Reached the finals at four of her first five events in 2020 before the WTA Tour was suspended for more than five months due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Won her second WTA title in Hobart and became the first Kazakh player to break into the WTA top 20. * Reached the French Open quarter-finals in 2021 and finished the year ranked 14th. * Defeated Ons Jabeur in her first Wimbledon final in 2022 to win her maiden Grand Slam title. * Reached her second Grand Slam final at the 2023 Australian Open, where she lost to Sabalenka in three sets, and made her top-10 debut after the tournament. * Won three titles from five finals in 2024, lifting trophies in Brisbane, Abu Dhabi and Stuttgart, while finishing runner-up in Doha and Miami. * Won three titles in 2025, adding Strasbourg and Ningbo crowns to her Riyadh triumph. Also captured her first WTA Finals title, beating world number one Sabalenka in the final. * Defeated Sabalenka again in the 2026 Australian Open final to win her second Grand Slam title. * Secured the world number one ranking by reaching the U.S. Open semi-finals and will become the first Kazakhstan player to reach the top of the women's rankings. She is guaranteed to take over the top spot when the rankings are updated on Monday. * Overcame an ankle injury that had threatened to derail her U.S. Open campaign before it began and went on to beat Sabalenka in the final, securing her third Grand Slam title.

item.title: Ruthless Rybakina dethrones Sabalenka to capture first US Open crown
item.description: Dressed in a yellow-and-black outfit that evoked a bee, Rybakina produced some stinging groundstrokes.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: [USN:L4N45402H TEXT:"Elena Rybakina"] delivered a devastating display to dethrone two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka with a 6-4 5-7 6-2 win in the [USN:L6N4530M0 TEXT:"U.S. Open"] final on Saturday, earning a third Grand Slam crown to accompany her ascent to world number one. The Russian-born Kazakh's icy composure on the grand stage helped her snap Sabalenka's 20-match winning streak at Flushing Meadows and denied the Belarusian the chance to emulate Serena Williams and Chris Evert with three straight New York titles. An [USN:L6N45408Y TEXT:"ankle injury"] had threatened to derail Rybakina's campaign even before the tournament started, but the 27-year-old shrugged off those concerns to add the U.S. Open title to her Australian Open triumph this year and Wimbledon success in 2022. "It's tough to find words ... I didn't expect anything like this coming into the tournament," said Rybakina, who became only the third woman this century to claim both hardcourt majors in the same year after Sabalenka and Angelique Kerber. "I've been dealing a bit with an injury. Somehow, everything aligned together on my side. Aryna ... it's so difficult to play against you. You push me to the limit. "I want to say thank you to the beautiful spectators for such a beautiful atmosphere. I'm falling in love with New York more and more." Saturday's title showdown at Arthur Ashe Stadium had all the ingredients of a classic between the top two in the rankings, and though Sabalenka brought late aggression, Rybakina was typically unruffled and prevailed to pocket the $5.5 million prize. "It's going to be different to wake up the next morning knowing you've won the U.S. Open and achieved the world number one ranking," said Rybakina, who collected her trophy from Russian five-time Grand Slam champion Maria Sharapova. "It's a relief, because you do all the routines for the past two to three weeks. It's a lot of work, a lot of nerves also." STINGING GROUNDSTROKES Dressed in a yellow-and-black match kit that evoked a bee, Rybakina produced some stinging groundstrokes but was unable to make the early pressure count as Sabalenka unleashed big serves to hold firm in the pair's third Grand Slam final meeting. The second seed drew first blood to go ahead 3-2 following a Sabalenka double fault, with the frustrated Belarusian earning a code violation immediately afterwards for launching a ball high into the stands of the main showcourt. "It's really tough to control your emotions when you lose in the final of the Grand Slam and when you're trying to go for the 'three-peat' so I wanted to let it go," Sabalenka said. "If I had held it inside, I wouldn't be able to say a word." Sabalenka's [USN:L1N45406Y TEXT:"irritation"] became increasingly evident with each missed shot and squandered opportunity, in stark contrast to the trademark calm etched on Rybakina's face as the Kazakh tightened her grip on the opening set and clinched it with a tight hold. A sudden drop-off in Rybakina's level midway through the second set gave the 28-year-old Sabalenka hope, and she produced a delicate drop shot and a stunning backhand crosscourt winner en route to forcing a deciding set. Sabalenka let out a roar after another backhand winner to hold in a tight opening game of the third set. COMMANDING LEAD However, Rybakina's quality shone through her red-and-blue-framed racket as she took a commanding 5-2 lead and then closed out a famous triumph to leave her Belarusian rival without any major silverware in 2026. The typically mild-mannered Rybakina's celebration had little more pizzazz than one might expect from a routine match victory, and she calmly packed her belongings at her bench as Sabalenka sat with her demolished racket. "It's the last thing I want to do right now, give a speech. But I'll try my very best," said a teary Sabalenka, who lost to Rybakina in the Australian Open final this year. "I'm disappointed, but I want to congratulate Elena. I wish I could perform a bit better, but I guess next year." The [USN:L6N45407L TEXT:"action"] resumes on Sunday with [USN:L6N454078 TEXT:"another final"], where Ben Shelton bids to end a 23-year American wait for a men's Grand Slam champion when he plays top seed Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Blue Jays outlast Orioles as teams battle to stay in playoff race
item.description: Alejandro Kirk belted a two-run home run and had three RBIs Saturday afternoon to help the Toronto Blue Jays defeat the visiting Baltimore Orioles 7-3.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Alejandro Kirk belted a two-run home run and had three RBIs Saturday afternoon to help the Toronto Blue Jays defeat the visiting Baltimore Orioles 7-3. The teams have split the first two of the three-game series in their pursuit of an American League playoff spot. The Blue Jays (74-75) are one game behind the Cleveland Guardians (75-74) for the third and final AL wild-card spot. The Orioles (72-77) are three behind. Brett Bateman added a solo shot for the Blue Jays. Toronto opener Spencer Miles escaped a bases-loaded jam in the first on Christian Encarnacion-Strand's fly out to the warning track in right. The Blue Jays took a 2-0 lead against Kyle Bradish (7-14) in the home first. Bateman led off with a walk, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stroked an RBI double to right-center with one out and Kirk followed with an RBI single to right. Bateman, who hit his first major league home run in the ninth on Friday, homered to right on a 1-1 fastball to open the home third. George Springer singled and Kirk connected with a first-pitch slider for a homer to left with one out to give Toronto a 5-0 lead. Bradish allowed five runs, eight hits and two walks with two strikeouts in three innings. Baltimore scored once in the fourth against Spencer Arrighetti (8-9). Gunnar Henderson smashed a one-out double into the right field corner and scored when Kazuma Okamoto bobbled Encarnacion-Strand's grounder and then threw high to first. The damage was limited when Encarnacion-Strand was thrown at home by Nathan Lukes on Colton Cowser's line single to right. Mason Fluharty replaced Arrighetti after Encarnacion-Strand took a two-out walk in the sixth. Pinch hitter Jeremiah Jackson doubled to right-center to put runners at second and third. Pinch hitter Rece Hinds ended the threat on a lineout to center. The Blue Jays scored a run against Anthony Nunez in their sixth. Josh Smith was hit by a pitch and scored on Andres Gimenez's double into the right field corner. Baltimore cut the lead to 6-3 in the seventh. Pinch hitter Yohel Pozo led off with a single against Fluharty. Pete Alonso homered down the left field line against Paul Sewald on a 1-2 sweeper. Toronto answered with a run in the bottom of the seventh. Guerrero was hit by a pitch, Lukes singled and Okamoto walked against Cam Sanders. Pinch hitter Ernie Clement greeted Luis De Leon with a sacrifice fly. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Astros considering Carlos Correa at 2B upon return
item.description: The Houston Astros are weighing moving Carlos Correa to second base upon his return to the lineup, per The Athletic.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Houston Astros are weighing moving Carlos Correa to second base upon his return to the lineup, per The Athletic. According to the report, the team views Correa as a potentially better solution at second than Jose Altuve or Isaac Paredes. He would man the position, when Yordan Alvarez is in left field. According to the report, when Alvarez is in left field, the Astros would keep Paredes at third and Jeremy Pena at shortstop with Correa playing second. Christian Walker would play first and Altuve would serve as the designated hitter. The 31-year-old Correa is coming off ankle surgery and has been fielding ground balls at third base. He has been limited to 32 games this season. During that span, he recorded three home runs and 16 RBIs with a .369 on-base percentage. The 2021 Platinum Glove winner has been a shortstop throughout his career, but he began spending time at third base last season to fit alongside teammate and 2022 Gold Glove winner Pena. --Field Level Media

item.title: Explosión sacude a otra planta de armas de EMCO en Bulgaria; se inicia una investigación
item.description: Bulgaria está investigando la causa de un incendio en un almacén de armas gestionado por EMCO, incluida la posibilidad de sabotaje y su vínculo con un incendio anterior ocurrido en otra de las instalaciones de la empresa en agosto, dijo el ministro del Interior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bulgaria está investigando la causa de un incendio en un almacén de armas gestionado por EMCO, incluida la posibilidad de sabotaje y su vínculo con un incendio anterior ocurrido en otra de las instalaciones de la empresa en agosto, dijo el ministro del Interior. No se han registrado heridos en el incendio, que se declaró cerca de la localidad de Tsareva Livada e iluminó el cielo nocturno, según los videos difundidos en los medios locales. El incidente se produjo semanas después de una explosión y un incendio en otro depósito de armas de EMCO en el oeste de Bulgaria. El ministro del Interior, Ivan Demerdzhiev, dijo el sábado a periodistas que el incendio estaba bajo control y que se estaba llevando a cabo una investigación. "Revisaremos casos anteriores en los que se produjeron incendios similares en los almacenes de esta empresa, así como en otras empresas, con el fin de buscar una posible conexión o un patrón similar", afirmó. "No descartamos una intervención externa". EMCO dijo posteriormente en un comunicado que el incendio fue resultado de un sabotaje, citando más de diez incidentes similares en empresas de defensa búlgaras desde 2011, aunque no identificó a ningún sospechoso. "No hay motivos para suponer que este caso sea diferente", señaló la empresa. EMCO está dirigida por el comerciante de armas búlgaro Emilian Gebrev, de quien la fiscalía búlgara ha afirmado anteriormente que fue objeto de ataques contra sus instalaciones por parte de agentes rusos. En 2024, Bulgaria dictó órdenes de detención contra seis ciudadanos rusos acusados de participar en la destrucción de los depósitos de armas de EMCO, donde se almacenaban municiones destinadas a la exportación a Ucrania y Georgia entre 2011 y 2020. Los fiscales dijeron en aquel momento que tenían motivos para sospechar vínculos entre las explosiones en Bulgaria, un intento de envenenamiento de Gebrev en 2015 y las explosiones en depósitos de municiones en la República Checa en 2014. Moscú ha desmentido las acusaciones. Slavcho Dimiev, director de las instalaciones de producción de EMCO, confirmó el incendio del sábado en el almacén, que, según él, contiene principalmente munición, incluida una pequeña cantidad de proyectiles de calibre medio. La empresa también acusó a las autoridades de no proteger adecuadamente las instalaciones de defensa. "No se ha concluido ni una sola investigación sobre los más de diez incidentes de este tipo ocurridos en las principales empresas del sector", dijo la empresa, añadiendo que su almacén ha sido inspeccionado siete veces desde principios de año, la última de ellas 20 días antes. Demerdzhiev expresó su preocupación por la seguridad y las condiciones en las que se almacenan los explosivos, así como por la forma en que se vigilan estas instalaciones. La explosión se produce en un momento de agitación política en Bulgaria, después de que el primer ministro Rumen Radev llegó al poder en abril con un programa favorable al Kremlin. En junio, el recién nombrado ministro de Defensa, Dimitar Stoyanov, dijo que Bulgaria ya no suministraría armas a Ucrania e instó a Moscú y a Kiev a sentarse a la mesa de negociaciones para poner fin a la guerra.

item.title: Nueva película de Rebel Wilson rinde homenaje al poder femenino tras "revés" en debut como directora
item.description: La actriz australiana Rebel Wilson regresó al Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto con su segundo largometraje como directora, "Girl Group", que combina "comedia, música y diversión", dijo a Reuters, tras una batalla legal en torno a su primera película.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Law
item.content:encoded: La actriz australiana Rebel Wilson regresó al Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto con su segundo largometraje como directora, "Girl Group", que combina "comedia, música y diversión", dijo a Reuters, tras una batalla legal en torno a su primera película. El debut como directora de Wilson, "The Deb", que se estrenó en el festival hace dos años, se vio envuelto en disputas legales que retrasaron el estreno de la película en los cines. En julio, un tribunal de Sídney absolvió a Wilson de difamar a la actriz principal de "The Deb", Charlotte MacInnes, quien había presentado una apelación. "Me alegré mucho de que un tribunal fallara de forma abrumadora a mi favor a principios de este año. Y creo que 'The Deb' sufrió un revés debido al litigio iniciado por los otros productores", dijo Wilson a Reuters en una entrevista el sábado. "Por mi parte, en general, mantuve un perfil bajo, trabajé en 'Girl Group' mientras tanto y viví una experiencia sensacional y muy divertida con ese proyecto". Los productores de "The Deb" interpusieron otra demanda contra Wilson ante un tribunal estadounidense. Su nueva comedia musical narra la historia de una estrella del pop caída en desgracia que fue excluida de la gira de reencuentro de su antiguo grupo femenino y que, como parte de una condena de servicios comunitarios, tiene que actuar como mentora de un grupo de chicas jóvenes. "'Girl Group' es una auténtica celebración de la música de los grupos de chicas de las últimas cinco décadas", dijo Wilson, que interpreta el papel protagonista y, al mismo tiempo, dirige, escribe y produce la película. "Es una historia sobre la amistad, sobre trabajar juntas para crear algo grandioso". La película cuenta con la participación de auténticas leyendas de los grupos de chicas, entre ellas Melanie Chisholm, de las Spice Girls; Shaznay Lewis, de All Saints; y Ashley Roberts y Nicole Scherzinger, de las Pussycat Dolls. Wilson contó que su película fue rechazada en su momento por un estudio por tratarse de una película "protagonizada por mujeres". "Me sorprendió mucho, porque he participado en películas corales protagonizadas por mujeres que tuvieron un éxito enorme y recaudaron cientos de millones de dólares", dijo Wilson, que protagonizó "Bridesmaids" y la saga "Pitch Perfect". "Girl Group" se estrenó el viernes en el TIFF, y aún no se ha anunciado la fecha de estreno en cines.

item.title: Rangers activate RHP Nathan Eovaldi, 3B Josh Jung from IL
item.description: The Texas Rangers activated right-hander Nathan Eovaldi (right posterior elbow inflammation) from the 15-day injured list and third baseman Josh Jung (left calf strain) from the 10-day injured list on Saturday prior to the Rangers' game against the host Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Texas Rangers activated right-hander Nathan Eovaldi (right posterior elbow inflammation) from the 15-day injured list and third baseman Josh Jung (left calf strain) from the 10-day injured list on Saturday prior to the Rangers' game against the host Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix. In corresponding moves, catcher Logan O'Hoppe and left-hander Adam Macko were optioned to Triple-A Round Rock. Eovaldi has posted a 4.21 ERA, 1.206 WHIP and 137 strikeouts in 22 starts this season. The two-time All-Star had a blistering 1.73 ERA, 0.854 WHIP and 129 strikeouts in 22 starts last season. He has been out of action since Aug. 7, with the same injury also causing him to miss time in 2025. At the time of his injury, Eovaldi was leading Texas in wins and innings pitched. Jung has nine home runs, 35 RBIs and a .294/.361/.441 slash line in 92 games this season. Jung has not played for the Rangers since July 22. He recently completed a rehab assignment with Triple-A Round Rock, including starts at third base in his final two games. Prior to his rehab stint, Jung has kept up his strength over the past several weeks by completing all daily baseball activities except full-speed running. Eovaldi and Jung are expected to add a valuable boost to the Rangers in the stretch run. Texas entered play on Saturday three games out of the final American League wild-card spot. O'Hoppe was acquired from the Los Angeles Angels in July. The 26-year-old appeared in 10 games for the Rangers, going 6-for-17 with one RBI. Macko has pitched 6 2/3 innings for the Rangers this season, allowing six earned runs, 12 hits and three walks to go along with seven strikeouts. --Field Level Media

item.title: Missed chance for Paris FC, Lyon as they slip behind Ligue 1 leaders
item.description: Paris FC and Olympique Lyonnais played out a goalless draw in Ligue 1 on Saturday, both missing out on the opportunity to grab a share of the lead in the early part of the new French season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paris FC and Olympique Lyonnais played out a goalless draw in Ligue 1 on Saturday, both missing out on the opportunity to grab a share of the lead in the early part of the new French season. The result left the two clubs on eight points from four games, two behind Monaco, who drew at RC Strasbourg earlier, and Rennes, who were 1-0 home victors over Olympique de Marseille on Friday. Both Paris and Lyon had chances in the French capital, with the home side’s winger Luca Koleosho coming closest with a 50th-minute effort that was inches wide. New Italy coach Roberto Mancini was in the crowd to watch Koleosho, who won his first caps in June. There was also a goalless draw between Le Havre and Angers but AJ Auxerre moved off the bottom of the table with a late 1-0 victory over Nice while Toulouse fought back from 0-2 down at halftime to win a point on the road at Lorient. Ibrahima Balde, in his first Ligue 1 start at the age of 23, opened the scoring in the 37th minute, and defender Noah Mbamba added a second two minutes later to have hosts Lorient in command at the break. Substitute Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for Toulouse three minutes into the second half before fellow Dane Thomas Jorgensen equalised in the 68th minute. AUXERRE EARN FIRST POINTS OF THE SEASON Auxerre’s win at home to Nice was their first points of the season after losing their opening three games, with Cameron Archer grabbing the 74th minute winner. Nice, who narrowly avoided relegation last season, dropped into last place. Monaco had gone top earlier in the day when a speculative long-range effort from Paris Brunner saw them force a 1-1 draw at RC Strasbourg on Saturday. Brunner scored in the 71st minute, picking up the ball just over the halfway line, advancing forward and then unleashing a shot that bent into the top corner of the home side’s net. Strasbourg had gone ahead seven minutes into the second half when Spanish defender Oso’s free kick was headed into his own net by Monaco’s Sadibou Sane. Monaco now have 10 points from their opening four matches and are ahead of Rennes on goal difference. Sunday sees Lille have a chance to join Monaco on 10 points as they host newly promoted Troyes while champions Paris St Germain look for their first win of the league season at Stade Brestois.

item.title: Thriller de Courteney Cox narra un "amor disfuncional" tras el caso del bombardero de la pizza
item.description: El thriller de Courteney Cox "Evil Genius", inspirado en un crimen real y que narra el infame caso del "bombardero de la pizza" en Estados Unidos, se estrenó el sábado en el Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Patrick Jones
item.content:encoded: El thriller de Courteney Cox "Evil Genius", inspirado en un crimen real y que narra el infame caso del "bombardero de la pizza" en Estados Unidos, se estrenó el sábado en el Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto. La película, protagonizada por la ganadora de un Óscar Patricia Arquette y el actor de "Stranger Things" David Harbour, es el primer largometraje de la estrella de "Friends" como directora en 12 años, tras la comedia negra de 2014 "Antes de Partir". Está basada en la serie documental de Netflix de 2018 "Evil Genius: The True Story of America’s Most Diabolical Bank Heist". La película gira en torno a la intrincada trama en la que Brian Wells, un repartidor de pizzas, atracó un banco PNC cerca de Erie, en Pensilvania, en 2003 con una bomba casera atada al cuello. El artefacto detonó tras su detención, causándole la muerte. Arquette interpreta a Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong, una mujer con trastorno bipolar que posteriormente fue condenada por el atraco. La fiscalía dijo que ella lo planeó para reunir dinero con el que contratar a un sicario que matara a su padre a raíz de una disputa por una herencia. Harbour interpreta a Bill Rothstein, su antiguo prometido y cómplice. Su llamada a la policía —en la que denunció el cadáver del novio de Diehl-Armstrong, James Roden, hallado en su congelador e implicó a ella en el asesinato— fue lo que desató el caso. Cox dijo en la alfombra roja que lo que le atrajo de la historia fue la inusual relación entre Diehl-Armstrong y Rothstein. "Hay una historia de amor disfuncional que es, en realidad, el catalizador de este atraco", explicó Cox en el estreno. "Hubo momentos realmente divertidos y también trágicos, pero pensé: 'Voy a mantener el equilibrio y contar la historia con un tono que… no se identifique con ningún género específico'". Arquette dijo que se esforzó por captar qué motivaba a Diehl-Armstrong, quien falleció en prisión en 2017. "A menudo, las personas que son los malos no se ven realmente a sí mismas como tales. Tienen sus razones por las que esa persona es su enemiga, o por las que esa persona les falló, o por las que deberían tener aquello, o por cómo el mundo les ha fastidiado", dijo. "Entender esos fundamentos fue, creo, lo más importante para mí".

item.title: Mbappé marca un doblete en goleada del Real Madrid ante el Rayo Vallecano
item.description: Kylian Mbappé marcó dos goles en la victoria por 4-1 del Real Madrid sobre el Rayo Vallecano, en un partido disputado el sábado por LaLiga española de fútbol en el estadio Santiago Bernabéu.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappé marcó dos goles en la victoria por 4-1 del Real Madrid sobre el Rayo Vallecano, en un partido disputado el sábado por LaLiga española de fútbol en el estadio Santiago Bernabéu. Álvaro Carreras y Jude Bellingham completaron el marcador a favor del equipo dirigido por José Mourinho. Mbappé abrió el marcador a los 14 minuto mediante un lanzamiento penal y tres minutos después asistió a Carreras, que definió con un remate sencillo. Un Real Madrid relajado apenas encontró resistencia por parte del Rayo a partir de entonces y, a 11 minutos del descanso, Vinicius Junior se internó por la izquierda para asistir a Bellingham, que remató con precisión al segundo palo. A los seis minutos de la segunda parte, Sergio Camello recortó distancias para el Rayo tras un error del Real Madrid. A pesar de los silbidos de la afición local, el Real mantuvo al Rayo bajo control, antes de sentenciar el partido con un gol de Mbappé a los 90 minutos. Con este resultado, el Real Madrid suma 12 puntos y empata con el líder, el Barcelona, que tiene un partido menos.

item.title: Mbappe scores brace as Real Madrid get 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid enjoyed a 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid enjoyed a 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday. Mbappe got his sixth goal of the season in the 14th minute, from a penalty, after Rayo defender Florian Lejeune fouled Alvaro Carreras in the box. Three minutes later Carreras exchanged passes with Mbappe, after Lejeune had gifted the ball to Vinicius Junior, and sent a shot into the net. Wingers Vinicius and Yan Diomande, making his first start for Real since joining in August, found ample space to operate in and after 34 minutes the Brazilian raced down the left before picking out Jude Bellingham, just inside the box, who side-footed into the bottom corner with minimal fuss. Mbappe hit the post late in the first half but the only danger to Real goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois's clean sheet came from a long-range strike by Andrei Ratiu which the Belgian pushed away. The lack of tension was evident early in the second period, with Rayo's Pedro Diaz hitting the post. The visitors pulled a goal back after 51 minutes when, after a cheap giveaway, Sergio Camello sneaked the ball through Ibrahima Konate's legs and into the corner of the net. Rayo were now enjoying comfortable possession in the Real Madrid half and were keeping Courtois busy. On the Real Madrid bench, manager Jose Mourinho's anger was mirrored by whistles from the crowd. With 13 minutes to go, Real's Denzel Dumfries drew a spectacular save from goalkeeper Emil Audero after connecting with substitute Arda Guler's cross. Real Madrid closed out the game with a second goal from Mbappe on the counter-attack in the 91st minute, moving him on to seven goals in six games in all competitions. The result put Real Madrid on 12 points, level with leaders Barcelona who play Levante on Sunday. Espanyol beat Osasuna 2-0 with an early brace from Roberto Fernandez, while Racing Santander came from behind to defeat in-form Alaves 2-1. Elche went ahead at San Mames through a second-half penalty from Facundo Buonanotte, but Athletic Club captain Inaki Williams found an equaliser with 11 minutes remaining and the game finished 1-1.

item.title: Nico Hoerner’s bases-loaded HBP lifts Cubs past Pirates
item.description: Nico Hoerner was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded in the eighth inning to force in the go-ahead run as the Chicago Cubs pulled out a 4-3 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nico Hoerner was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded in the eighth inning to force in the go-ahead run as the Chicago Cubs pulled out a 4-3 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday. Pedro Ramirez had a double and a home run, and Michael Busch hit a solo shot for the Cubs (83-66). Ryan Rolison (9-1) allowed one hit in 1 2/3 scoreless innings to earn the win. Ryan Zeferjahn struck out Bryan Reynolds looking for the final out and his sixth save. Ryan O'Hearn hit a three-run home run, and Paul Skenes allowed two runs on four hits, walking one and fanning four over seven innings for the Pirates (74-75). The Cubs rallied from a 3-2 deficit in the eighth against Pirates reliever Gregory Soto (6-5), who allowed a leadoff double to Ramirez. Tyrone Taylor flied out, and Pete Crow-Armstrong struck out looking before Alex Bregman was hit by a pitch and pinch hitter Seiya Suzuki walked to load the bases. Pinch hitter Matt Shaw drew an RBI walk to tie the game at 3-all. Hoerner was then hit by a pitch, forcing home Bregman. Chicago got on the scoreboard in the first when Busch cranked an opposite-field solo homer 415 feet over the wall in left field. In the third, Ramirez gave the Cubs a 2-0 lead when he launched a home run to right. The Pirates took a 3-2 lead in the sixth when Brandon Lowe opened the frame with a single and Reynolds followed with a slow roller that Hoerner misplayed for an error, putting runners on first and second. Konnor Griffin flied out to right, advancing both runners, before O'Hearn's three-run homer gave Pittsburgh the lead. Spencer Horwitz followed with a walk and Jake Mangum popped out to right, but Jacob Gonzalez singled and Henry Davis walked to load the bases. Cubs starter Clay Holmes was relieved by Jacob Webb. Oneil Cruz grounded out to second as Webb escaped the inherited jam. Holmes allowed three runs (two earned) on five hits with four walks and six strikeouts over 5 2/3 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Arteta angry over penalty decision despite Arsenal win at Sunderland
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta labelled the decision to award Sunderland a penalty 'unacceptable' on Saturday after watching his side grind out a 2-0 win to maintain their 100% start to the season and move clear at the top of the Premier League.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta labelled the decision to award Sunderland a penalty 'unacceptable' on Saturday after watching his side grind out a 2-0 win to maintain their 100% start to the season and move clear at the top of the Premier League. As it was, keeper David Raya pushed Enzo Le Fee's spot kick against the post in the 55th minute and two minutes later Bruno Guimaraes scored his first goal for the club. Bukayo Saka wrapped it up deep in stoppage time from the penalty spot to make it four leagues wins out of four for the reigning champions. It could have been different had Le Fee found the net but Arteta blasted the decision by referee John Brooks to award a penalty when Ezri Konsa was penalised for pulling down Dan Ballard as a corner was played in. "It was a huge win but it could have been something very different," an angry Arteta told TNT Sport when referring to the penalty award. "It's unacceptable at this level, this can change the course of a season and the championship. It's not acceptable. I've seen it 10 times to make sure and it's not possible at this level that it can be a penalty. It cannot happen. "It's not a penalty in any context, in any league." It was far from a vintage Arsenal display against a tenacious Sunderland, who deserved something for their endeavour, but they dug deep and showed the resilience that helped them win a first title for 22 years last season. They have now kept four clean sheets in their five games since the start of the season, including in the Champions League win at Napoli in midweek. Summer signing Guimaraes replaced Myles Lewis-Skelly at halftime and made a stunning impact. After receiving a pass from Declan Rice he sent a right-footed curler into the top corner. Arsenal were forced to defend desperately at times as Sunderland's physicality rattled them but Saka netted his third goal of the season when he beat Robin Roefs with his spot kick after being fouled by Reinildo Mandava who was sent off. "It's unbelievable the spirit and the courage we have to go again and again and again," Arteta said. "So pleased in one sense and so worried in another. "David Raya was unbelievable. He is a player that decides football matches when we need it. "Sunderland deserve a lot of credit for the way they make it so hard for you." Manchester City, the only other side not to have dropped Premier League points this season, can join Arsenal on 12 points if they beat Manchester United on Sunday.

item.title: President Trump ‘absolutely’ plans to attend 2027 Ryder Cup
item.description: Making a pitch for the Ryder Cup to be held at a golf course he owns in Scotland, President Donald Trump on Saturday said he would "absolutely" be in attendance at 2027's edition regardless.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Making a pitch for the Ryder Cup to be held at a golf course he owns in Scotland, President Donald Trump on Saturday said he would "absolutely" be in attendance at 2027's edition regardless. "I will, absolutely," Trump said. "It's a big tournament." Trump has been in Dublin, Ireland to meet with Irish president Catherine Connolly and taoiseach Michael Martin. He expressed interest in seeing a united Ireland to spark some controversy while making his Ryder pitch for his course located in Turnberry. "I do think the Ryder Cup should be held in Turnberry but it won't be - probably because they give it out 10 years in advance," Trump said. The timing of Trump's current trip was scheduled to line up with the Irish Open on the DP World Tour at Trump's course north of Doonbeg. Ireland's Shane Lowry has grabbed the lead at that event through three rounds at 16 under. --Field Level Media

item.title: Courteney Cox thriller tells 'dysfunctional love story' behind pizza bomber case at TIFF
item.description: Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Patrick Jones
item.content:encoded: Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday. The film, starring Academy Award winner Patricia Arquette and "Stranger Things" actor David Harbour, is the "Friends" star's first feature film as a director in 12 years, following the 2014 black comedy "Just Before I Go." It is based on the 2018 Netflix documentary series "Evil Genius: The True Story of America's Most Diabolical Bank Heist." The movie centers on the convoluted plot in which pizza delivery man Brian Wells robbed a PNC Bank near Erie, Pennsylvania, in 2003 with a homemade bomb locked around his neck. The device detonated after his arrest, killing him. Arquette plays Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong, a woman with bipolar disorder who was later convicted of the robbery. Prosecutors said she masterminded it to raise money to hire a hit man to kill her estranged father over an inheritance dispute. Harbour co-stars as Bill Rothstein, her former fiancé and accomplice. His call to police - reporting the body of Diehl-Armstrong's boyfriend James Roden in his freezer and implicating her in the killing - broke the case open. Cox said on the red carpet she was drawn to the story by the unusual relationship between Diehl-Armstrong and Rothstein. "There's a dysfunctional love story that's really the catalyst for this heist," Cox said at the premiere. "There were some really humorous moments and also tragic, but I just thought 'I'm going to walk the line, tell the story with a tone that's ... not identifiable with any specific genre.'" Arquette said she strove to capture what motivated Diehl-Armstrong, who died in prison in 2017. "Oftentimes, people who are bad guys, they don't really see themselves as that. They have their reasons why that person's their enemy, or that person let them down, or they should have that thing, or how the world screwed them over," she said. "Understanding those underpinnings, I think, was the most important to me."

item.title: Rebel Wilson’s new film celebrates girl power after ‘setback’ in directorial debut
item.description: Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Law
item.content:encoded: Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film. Wilson’s directorial debut “The Deb,” which premiered at the festival two years ago, was embroiled in legal disputes, delaying the film’s release in theaters. In July, a Sydney court [USN:P8N3X103B TEXT:"cleared "]Wilson of defaming The Deb's lead actor Charlotte MacInnes, who was appealing. “I was so happy to have a court rule overwhelmingly in my favor earlier this year. And I feel like ‘The Deb’ did have a setback because of the litigation that was brought by the other producers,” Wilson told Reuters in an interview on Saturday. “I, for the most part, kept my head down, worked on ‘Girl Group’ in the meantime and just had such a sensational, fun experience on that.” A separate lawsuit was filed against Wilson by "The Deb" producers in a U.S. court. Her new musical comedy follows the story of a disgraced pop star who was excluded from her former girl group’s reunion tour and has to mentor a group of young girls under a community-service sentence. “’Girl Group’ is a full-on celebration of girl group music from throughout like the past five decades,” said Wilson, who plays the lead while also directing, writing and producing the film. “It’s a story about friendship, about working together to create something great.” The film features real girl group legends, including Spice Girls' Melanie Chisholm, All Saints’ Shaznay Lewis and Pussycat Dolls’ Ashley Roberts and Nicole Scherzinger. Wilson said that her film was once rejected by a studio because it was a “female-driven” film. “I was shocked by that because I've been in these female-driven ensemble movies that were absolutely huge and made hundreds of millions of dollars,” said Wilson, who starred in “Bridesmaids” and the “Pitch Perfect” series. “Girl Group” premiered at TIFF on Friday, and a release date in theatres has not yet been announced.

item.title: Hao-Yu Lee fuels Tigers’ comeback win over Rockies
item.description: Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday. Lee had three hits, scored twice and drove in three runs. Max Clark supplied three hits while scoring a run and knocking in another. Eduardo Valencia also had three of Detroit's 18 hits while Kevin McGonigle added a solo homer for the Tigers (69-79). Detroit became the first team since Philadelphia on Sept. 23, 2024, to have its leadoff batter reach safely in eight consecutive innings. Hunter Goodman blasted a three-run homer for the Rockies (55-93), who have lost six straight. Detroit starter Andrew Sears gave up four runs and seven hits in 4 1/3 innings. Colorado starter Tanner Gordon allowed four runs and 10 hits in four innings. Down 7-4 in the eighth, the Tigers rallied against Jaden Hill (1-4). Lee led off with a double and scored on Gleyber Torres' double. Riley Greene knocked in Torres with a single. A single and a walk loaded the bases before Hill was replaced by Jordan Romano, who walked Spencer Torkelson and Ben Malgeri to force in the tying and go-ahead runs. John Peck drove in Clark with a sacrifice fly to make it 9-7. With two outs, Lee ripped an opposite-field triple to bring in Torkelson and Malgeri. Colorado took a 3-0 lead in the third on Goodman's 38th homer. Detroit got two of those runs back in the bottom of the inning. McGonigle powered a changeup over the right-field wall to lead off the frame. After back-to-back two-out singles by Greene and Valencia, Clark smacked another single to right to bring in Greene. The Rockies took a 4-2 lead in the fourth on Adael Amador's double. The Tigers knotted the score at 4-all in the bottom of the inning on Lee's run-scoring double and Colt Keith's RBI single. Colorado regained the lead in the sixth on Jake McCarthy's two-run single, then took a 7-4 lead on Ezequiel Tovar's homer off Beau Brieske (1-0) in the top of the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: OpenAI's Altman won't do IPO this year, calls AI extinction risk 'unacceptable'
item.description: "I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public."
item.dc:creator: Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Chief Executive Sam Altman said in remarks published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence that render "unacceptable" even a 10% risk that AI could [USN:L6N4520JB TEXT:"cause human extinction"] by decade's end. The comments come as more U.S. [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"lawmakers"] urge new rules to govern AI systems after dire warnings from two researchers from OpenAI rival Anthropic that rapidly progressing AI could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future. "I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that," Altman told business magazine Fortune. Asked if there was a 10% chance of AI-driven extinction, [USN:L4N3CN16E TEXT:"Altman"] said he did not know how such an estimate could be made, but warned the risk was serious enough that AI companies and governments should act as though it could not be tolerated. "Whether it's 10 or eight or six, the point is, we all have a tremendous amount of responsibility, and cannot let egos or incentives for profit or anything else get in the way," Altman added. "We need to act such that we are not taking any of those numbers of risk, and I believe we can." INSTANCES OF AI AGENTS GOING ROGUE Politicians, both Democrat and Republican, have responded with alarm and calls for more action after cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems and AI safety researchers quitting their companies out of concern at the technology risks. In June, the New York Times said San Francisco-based OpenAI was considering [USN:L4N42X21Q TEXT:"whether to hold off"] until next year on a potentially trillion-dollar IPO. At the time, shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO were tumbling after a surge that sent that company's valuation to $1.8 trillion. Asked by Fortune if an IPO date of 2026 was off the table in favor of 2027, Altman said, "I would say not 2026. "We got a lot of stuff to do, like meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment, and how the industry and governments can work together." Altman also suggested that OpenAI and other leading AI firms may be close to unveiling a pact to slow AI development and work together to tackle safety risks, Fortune said. CALL FOR MORE DELIBERATE APPROACH On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged AI companies to take a more [USN:L1N45403P TEXT:"deliberate approach"] to development. "We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models," Amodei wrote in an essay on X. Altman later posted that he agreed with the sentiment. "I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," Altman wrote. "This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks." Safety concerns have not slowed Anthropic's own IPO plans. It is expected to [USN:L6N44W194 TEXT:"begin marketing"] its initial public offering in mid-October at the earliest and complete the listing days before the U.S. midterm elections in November, people familiar with the matter told Reuters this month.

item.title: Francisco Lindor powers Mets’ 6-homer rout of Yankees
item.description: Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon. Lindor added a grand slam in the eighth as the Mets (69-79) won for the fifth time in six games and improved to 22-13 since their big selloff at last month's trade deadline by hitting Cole (8-9) hard again. Rookie Zac Thornton (4-5) allowed two runs on five hits in a career-high-tying seven innings. The left-hander struck out four, walked one and threw first-pitch strikes to 17 of 26 hitters. Lindor got things started in the first inning by lifting a 1-1 changeup into the right-field seats. It was the shortstop's 36th career leadoff homer and fifth this season. Torrens homered for the seventh time in his past 27 appearances when he lifted a 1-2 fastball into the left-field seats for a 3-0 lead in the second inning. Benge added a solo shot in the third to push the Mets' advantage to 4-0. Benge added an RBI single that chased Cole from the contest with one out in the fifth. Juan Soto homered in the seventh, and Lindor hit his eighth career grand slam after Torrens hit an RBI double. Lindor has seven home runs in his past 12 games and 24 career multi-homer games. Jared Young also went deep with two outs in the ninth to give the Mets six homers against the Yankees for the first time. Cole was tagged for five runs on nine hits (three home runs) in 4 1/3 innings after allowing four homers in Sunday's loss at San Diego. He struck out four and didn't walk a batter as he matched his second-shortest outing since returning from Tommy John surgery on May 22. The right-hander has allowed 17 homers in 10 career starts against the Mets. He is 0-3 with a 10.93 ERA in his past three outings against them. The Yankees (85-63) had their four-game winning streak end. They entered the game needing both a win and a Toronto Blue Jays loss to secure a postseason berth for the ninth time in 10 seasons. Cody Bellinger hit a run-scoring single for the Yankees in the fourth. He added a solo homer in the sixth to pull the hosts to within 5-2 before the Mets put the game out of reach with a five-run eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Russian attacks kill six, injure dozens in Ukraine, Moscow says it hits ships, plants
item.description: KYIV: Russian air strikes in several Ukrainian regions on Saturday (Sep 12) killed nine people, injured dozens and damaged residential buildings and infrastructure across the country, officials said.The civilian death toll has risen sharply in Ukraine over the past two months
item.dc:creator: CNA

KYIV: Russian air strikes in several Ukrainian regions on Saturday (Sep 12) killed n ine people, injured dozens and damaged residential buildings and infrastructure across the country, officials said. The civilian death toll has risen sharply in Ukraine over the past two months as Russia steps up attacks on power plants and other infrastructure. Ukraine has hit energy facilities and warehouses in distant parts of Russia and both sides have targeted each others' shipping. T he city council in Kramatorsk, one of Ukraine's frontline "fortress cities" that Russia wants to capture, said Russian forces attacked private cars, killing three people in three incidents over a 90-minute period. Four people were injured. "These are not military targets," the council said. "They are ordinary civilian cars. People were going about their business."

The governor of Ukraine's Zhytomyr Region, west of Kyiv, Vitaliy Bunechko, said a Russian strike on a grocery store killed two people in the town of Zvyahel. Two petrol stations also came under attack as well as an unidentified "enterprise with foreign investment", he said. Earlier, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy reported attacks on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia and in his home town of Kryvyi Rih. The governor of Zaporizhzhia Region, Ivan Fedorov, said two people were killed and 11 injured in assaults on Zaporizhzhia and other localities. Oleksandr Vilkul, head of Kryvyi Rih's military administration, said two people had been killed in overnight attacks on the city by drones and missiles.

Related:

Zelenskyy says he is willing to meet Putin at G20 in Miami

Modi, Putin seek stronger ties as Russia calls for BRICS to counter West

The Russian military said its forces hit Ukrainian steel maker Zaporizhstal in the city of Zaporizhzhia, an Interpipe Steel complex in Dnipro and several plants in Kryvyi Rih, including the Northern Iron Ore Beneficiation Works complex. Reuters could not independently verify accounts from either side. In Odesa Region, Governor Oleh Kiper said 37 people, including an infant, had been injured in a series of overnight attacks. Two people were missing. RUSSIAN STRIKES ON UKRAINIAN PORT The Russian Defence Ministry said Moscow's forces had maintained their strikes on Ukrainian ports, hitting a cargo ship in Odesa it said was carrying goods for military use. Earlier in the day, the ministry said its forces had struck two cargo vessels overnight in the Black Sea port of Chornomorsk.

Related:

Zelenskyy warns airlines Russian skies not safe due to Ukraine drones

Russia sends bones of medieval warrior prince to Ukraine front to boost morale

Ukraine's military said it hit one of Russia's largest synthetic rubber producers in Togliatti in the Samara region, causing a fire. The Togliattikauchuk plant specialised in the production of synthetic rubbers and fuel additives that are used in fuel for Russian missiles, it said. Russian regional governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said industrial facilities in Samara region had been attacked by Ukrainian drones, without specifying which they were or whether they had been damaged, Interfax news agency reported. Ilya Sukhikh, mayor of the city of Togliatti in Samara region, said several residential buildings were damaged and one person was injured. In a separate attack, four commercial properties were set ablaze in the city of Taganrog in the Rostov region, local mayor Svetlana Kambulova said, according to TASS.

Source: Reuters/fs
